627.d: Kaljurahnudega mere ja punaste majakestega rannaküla taustal noore naise ja vana mehe poolfiguurid külgvaates vasakule. Vasakul valges pearätis, heledas riides noorik, käed sõrmseongus kõhu peal. Tema taga paremal kongus nina ja vuntsidega vana mees, sonimüts peas, hele särk musta vestiga seljas. Musti kontuure rõhutav joonistuslik laad. Maalipind näiliselt õhukeseks hõõrutud, kihiti läbipaistev.
627.de: Against the background of a sea with rocky cliffs and a coastal village with small red houses, half-figures of a young woman and an old man in side view facing left. On the left, a young woman in a white headscarf and light-coloured clothing, hands clasped over her stomach. Behind her on the right, an old man with a hooked nose and moustache, wearing a cap, a light shirt and a black waistcoat. A drawing-like manner emphasising black contours. The paint surface appears rubbed thin, translucent in layers.

628.d: Ekspressiivse musta kontuurjoonega markeeritud, peamiselt pruunides ja rohekates toonides antud maastikuvaade.  Esiplaanil abstraheeritud mets, millest eristatavad mõned puud ja teerada, taamal paistmas veekogu saartega.
628.de: A landscape view marked by an expressive black contour line, given mainly in brown and greenish tones. In the foreground an abstracted forest, from which a few trees and a path are distinguishable, further back a body of water with islands can be seen.

642.de: A full-length figure of a man sitting on a stool, with glasses, head turned to the right, right leg extended forward, left leg bent, a palette in his left hand, a brush in his right; Clothing: a longer work coat open at the front, under which a full suit and a closed-collar sweater are visible

682.d: Maali keskel inimeste grupid. Parempoolne grupp koosneb neljast inimesest, kellest kolm, otsevaates, vaatavad plaani, neljas selgvaates, vaatab vasakule. Vasempoolne grupp koosneb kahest töölisest, kellest üks on sirutanud oma käe. Parempoolses nurgas töötavad suure vasktoru kallal kaks teineteise poole olevat meest. Neist vasakul, toru suu ees, seisab esiplaanil selgvaates mees.(eesti)
682.de: In the centre of the painting groups of people. The right-hand group consists of four people, three of whom, in frontal view, are looking at a plan, the fourth, in profile, looks to the left. The left-hand group consists of two workers, one of whom has stretched out his arm. In the right corner two men facing each other are working on a large copper pipe. To the left of them, in front of the pipe's opening, stands a man in profile in the foreground.

684.d: Esiplaanil õitsva niidu riba, taga põllud rõukudega, kaugemal puud, põõsad. Vasakul vilja peksmine. Silmapiir sinavasse uttu kaduv.
684.de: In the foreground a strip of blossoming meadow, behind it fields with stacks, further away trees, bushes. On the left threshing of grain. The horizon disappearing into a bluish haze.

685.d: Esiplaanil laual valge draperii; kõrval keraamiline kann, kitarr, noodiraamatud.
685.de: In the foreground on a table a white drapery; next to it a ceramic jug, a guitar, sheet music books.

686.d: Esiplaanil all vasakul hall raamat paksu klaasiga, milles punane vedelik. Taga astmevõrra kõrgemal musta- ja punasekirjul draperiil sidrunid, pruun pudel, valge lame kann ja nende taga püsti punane ja pruun raamat. Hall foon.
686.de: In the foreground lower left a grey book with thick glass, containing a red liquid. Behind it, one step higher, on a black-and-red-patterned drapery lemons, a brown bottle, a white flat jug, and behind them a red and brown book standing upright. Grey background.

688.d: Esiplaanil merekallas, paremal rühm naisi seismas, kellest üks käed ettesirutatult kummardab. Vasakul lammas süles sisev naine ja kõrval laps. Tagapool lambakari ja lambaid pesevad naised vees.
688.de: In the foreground a seashore, on the right a group of women standing, one of whom is bowing with hands stretched forward. On the left a woman sitting with a lamb in her lap, and a child beside her. Further back a flock of sheep and women washing sheep in the water.

689.d: Esiplaanil põld viljarõukudega ja kahe hobusega. Sellest tagapool puude ja põõsaste vahel madalad hooned. Silmapiiril sinakad metsaga künkad. Taevas hele kuu.
689.de: In the foreground a field with grain stacks and two horses. Beyond it, among trees and bushes, low buildings. On the horizon bluish forested hills. A bright moon in the sky.

704.d: Esiplaanil rahulik, keskplaanil valges vahus tõusev vesi. Taustal kõrge kallas sügisese taimestikuga.
704.de: In the foreground calm, in the middle ground water rising in white foam. In the background a high bank with autumn vegetation.

705.d: Vanema istuva mehe 3/4 figuur otsevaates, pea kerges pöördes paremale. Käed toetuvad tooli käsipuudele. Hallitriibuline ülikond, must lips.
705.de: Three-quarter figure of an elderly seated man in frontal view, head slightly turned to the right. Hands resting on the armrests of the chair. Grey-striped suit, black tie.

706.d: Viiulit mängiva seisva poisi täisfiguur pöördes vasakule. Seljataga peegel, vasakul noodipult.
706.de: Full figure of a standing boy playing the violin, turned to the left. Behind him a mirror, to the left a music stand.

707.d: Lage rand. Vasakul meri. Esiplaanil väikesed kivid ja rannataimed.
707.de: Bare shore. On the left the sea. In the foreground small stones and shore plants.

709.d: Mehe portree otsevaates, seljas tuulepluus tõmbelukuga. Koloriit hallikas-pruun.
709.de: Frontal portrait of a man, wearing a windbreaker with a zipper. The colouring is grayish-brown.

717.d: Esiplaanil lage lumine tänav, tagapool ja vasakul ning paremal majad.
717.de: In the foreground an empty snowy street, behind and on the left and right houses.

780.d: Kahe abstraktse maali ees seisavad tagantvaates rohekas seelikus naine ja rohekas pintsakus habemik mees pea pöördes vasakule.
780.de: In front of two abstract paintings stand, seen from behind, a woman in a greenish skirt and a bearded man in a greenish jacket, his head turned to the left.

781.d: Poolabstraktne motiiv kahe peaga helesinise taeva taustal. Nii figuurid kui taust edasi antud vabakäelises geomeetrilises abstraheeringus.
781.de: Semi-abstract motif of two heads against a light blue sky background. Both the figures and the background are rendered in a freehand geometric abstraction.

790.d: Akna juures istuva tütarlapse poolfiguur. Punane, valgete täppidega kleit, valge krae. Tume juus kahes patsis. Käed süles.
790.de: Half-figure of a girl sitting by a window. Red dress with white dots, white collar. Dark hair in two braids. Hands in her lap.

791.d: Heledal aknalaual kollakas kann roosaõieliste okstega. Selle kõrval madal roosakas klaasvaas laia kannikeste kimbuga. Üldine koloriit hele, hallikas.
791.de: On a light windowsill a yellowish jug with pink-flowered branches. Beside it a low pinkish glass vase with a wide bunch of violets. The overall colouring is light, greyish.

792.d: Valge kraega, punane kleit/pluus, millel sinine põll/kleit punaste nööpidega.
792.de: With a white collar, a red dress/blouse, over which a blue apron/dress with red buttons.

793.d: Naise poolfiguur pöördes vasakule, pea otsevaates. Must jakk ja kollane pluus.
793.de: Half-figure of a woman turned to the left, head in frontal view. Black jacket and yellow blouse.

794.d: Avatud akna ees istuva tütarlapse kolmveerand figuur, käes õmblustöö. Temast paremal toolil istumas teine tütarlaps. Vasakul toolil seljaga istuv vanem naine.
794.de: Three-quarter figure of a girl sitting in front of an open window, sewing work in her hands. To her right another girl sitting on a chair. On the left an older woman sitting with her back turned, on a chair.

795.d: Diagonaalselt asetatud väiksel nelinurksel laual kolm lindu. Paremal lauanurgal võrk, mille peal kaks sidrunit. Üks sidrun veel vasakul lindude vahel.
795.de: Three birds placed diagonally on a small rectangular table. At the right corner of the table a net, on which two lemons. One more lemon between the birds on the left.

796.d: Tripiptühhon. Keskosal rühm inimesi, esiplaanil punakas kleidis naine kahe lapsega. Vasakul külgtiival ahervaremete taustal vana naine seljaga vaataja poole. Paremal külgtiival rühm triibulises rõivais meesvange traataia taga.
796.de: Triptych. In the central part a group of people, in the foreground a woman in a reddish dress with two children. On the left wing an old woman with her back to the viewer against a background of ruins. On the right wing a group of male prisoners in striped clothing behind barbed wire.

799.d: Esiplaanil avara akna all viis laudade ääres istuvat figuuri. Paremal seisev mees, vasakul ettekandja kandikuga. Aknast paistab punaseid lippe kandev rahvahulk.
799.de: In the foreground, under a wide window, five figures sitting at tables. On the right, a standing man; on the left, a waiter with a tray. Through the window, a crowd carrying red flags can be seen.

802.d: Peegli taustal kolm tütarlast balletikingades ja lühikeses tantsukleidis, paremad käed sirutatud, parem jalg varbal. Kahvatud toonid.
802.de: Against the background of a mirror, three girls in ballet shoes and short dance dresses, right arms extended, right foot en pointe. Pale tones.

820.d: Rohelistes ja sinistes toonides laigulisel foonil keskel suur kala. Kala selg roheline, kõhualune kollakas, uimed ja saba sinistes ja lillades toonides. Paremale jäävas peas teravate hammastega avatud suu, millest paistab allaneelatud kala sabaots.
820.de: A large fish in the centre against a mottled background in green and blue tones. The fish's back is green, its underside yellowish, its fins and tail in blue and lilac tones. In its head, positioned to the right, an open mouth with sharp teeth, from which the tail end of a swallowed fish protrudes.

821.d: Maastiku taustal olev, punast peakatet ja riietuseset kandev mehe poolportree profiilis; suu-silma, nina-kõrva, silma-huule hübriidid.(eesti)
821.de: A man's half-portrait in profile wearing a red headdress and item of clothing, against a landscape background; hybrids of mouth-eye, nose-ear, eye-lip.

822.d: Kunstniku naeratav ja lehvitav autoportree veerandpöördes paremale. Peas sinine müts ja prillid, suus suitsev piip ja seljas hallikas riideese. Maalitud realistlikus laadis, taust rohekas-hallikas.
822.de: The artist's smiling and waving self-portrait in a quarter-turn to the right. On the head a blue cap and glasses, a smoking pipe in the mouth and a grayish garment. Painted in a realistic style, background greenish-gray.

823.d: Kunstniku siilisoengus autoportree poolpöördes paremale. Ilme tõsine, peas prillid ja seljas sinine riideese. Maali käsitluslaad kergelt ekspressiivne.
823.de: The artist's self-portrait with a spiky hairstyle, in half-turn to the right. Serious expression, wearing glasses and a blue garment. The painting's style is slightly expressive.

824.d: Tõsine portree mütsi ja prillidega otsevaates. Peas hall müts ja seljas hall rõivas, nägu maalitud valgusküllaselt.
824.de: A serious portrait with a hat and glasses, in a frontal view. On his head a grey hat and wearing grey clothing, the face painted in bright light.

826.d: Piibu ja prillidega siilisoengus autoportree kerges pöördes paremale. Seljas sinine, eest lahtine pluus, käsi hoiab suus piipu. Taust roosa, vasakul rohelise triibuga.
826.de: Self-portrait with a pipe and glasses, hair in a crew cut, in a slight turn to the right. Wearing a blue blouse open at the front, hand holding a pipe in the mouth. Background pink, with a green stripe on the left.

827.d: Piibu ja prillidega otsevaates autoportree. Taust pastelsetes toonides, säbruline.
827.de: Frontal self-portrait with pipe and glasses. Background in pastel tones, wavy.

828.d: Pikemas potisoengus prillidega autoportree veerandpöördes paremale. Seljas kollakas-pruunikas ruuduline särk, taustal kevadine rohelus.
828.de: Self-portrait in a longer bowl haircut with glasses, in a three-quarter turn to the right. Wearing a yellowish-brown checked shirt, spring greenery in the background.

830.d: Kõrge sangaga korv täis punaseid ja valgeid astreid. Ees vasakul tühi pruun vaas.
830.de: A basket with a tall handle full of red and white asters. In front on the left an empty brown vase.

855.d: Linnatänav nelja figuuriga esiplaanil: keskel pruunis, karvase kraega palitus, käekoti ja kõrgekontsaliste hallide kingadega naine poolprofiilis, pruun madal kübar peas. Naise ümber kolm valgetes kitlites ja hallides sonides meest. Vasakpoolsel, vaataja poole seljaga seisval mehel ning parempoolsel, profiilis antud leivavedajal on käes kollased ovaalsed leivakorvid. Meeste taga paremal paistab pruuni leivafurgooni tagumine ots. Taamal kõrge kollane aiamüüritis, mille tagant paistavad pruunide katustega majad. Paremas ülaservas jupike hallikassinist taevast.
855.de: A city street with four figures in the foreground: in the centre a woman in half-profile, in a brown coat with a furry collar, with a handbag and grey high-heeled shoes, wearing a low brown hat. Around the woman three men in white smocks and grey caps. The man on the left, standing with his back to the viewer, and the bread carrier on the right, shown in profile, hold yellow oval bread baskets. Behind the men, on the right, the rear end of a brown bread van can be seen. In the background a tall yellow garden wall, behind which houses with brown roofs can be seen. In the upper right corner a piece of greyish-blue sky.

863.d: Figuraalne kompositsioon. Pildi keskmes kahe mehe poolfiguurid, kellest parempoolsel suits suus, vasakpoolsel habemega mehel valge rätik õlgadel. Pildi vasakus servas lilleline kardin, paremal arvatavasti must piaano.
863.de: Figural composition. In the centre of the picture, half-figures of two men, of whom the one on the right has a cigarette in his mouth, and the bearded man on the left has a white cloth on his shoulders. On the left edge of the picture a floral curtain, on the right presumably a black piano.

897.d: Vasakul madala õlgkatusega palkhoone ees grupp inimesi: lävepakul kannelt mängiv vanamees, madalal järil kala puhastav naine, vanamehe kõrval seisev naine. Tare seina ääres seisab Kreutzwald. Taga paremal värav, mille juures kookpuuga ämbrit kandev naine
897.de: On the left, in front of a log building with a low thatched roof, a group of people: on the threshold an old man playing the kannel, a woman cleaning fish on a low stool, a woman standing beside the old man. Kreutzwald stands by the wall of the cottage. Behind, on the right, a gate, by which a woman carries a bucket with a yoke

910.d: Väikese nelinurkse laua pind diagonaalvaates. Esiplaanil keskel kaks sigaretti ja tikutoos. Tagapool vasakul sanga ja valge korgiga klaaspudel.
910.de: The surface of a small rectangular table in diagonal view. In the foreground in the middle two cigarettes and a matchbox. Behind on the left a glass bottle with a handle and a white cork.

911.d: Õhtune suvemaastik. Esiplaanil roheline põld. Tagapool paremal hoonete grupp. Kaugemal vasakul teine rühm hooneid. Nende taga tume metsatukk. Metsa taga peaaegu kogu pildi laiuses helesine väike järv. Silmapiiril sinine viirg. Taevas kaugemal hele, soojema varjundiga. Kogu maali ulatuses kumab läbi ultramariinsinine krunt.
911.de: Evening summer landscape. Green field in the foreground. A group of buildings further back on the right. Another group of buildings further away on the left. A dark clump of forest behind them. Behind the forest, a small light-blue lake almost across the entire width of the painting. A blue streak on the horizon. The sky farther off is light, with a warmer tint. A ultramarine-blue ground shows through the whole extent of the painting.

912.d: Tumesinisel foonil kõrge vaas punaste moonidega. Paremal triibuline riie, esiplaanil klaas kahe väikese õiega.
912.de: Tall vase with red poppies on a dark blue background. Striped fabric on the right, glass with two small flowers in the foreground.

913.d: Rahvapeo stseen. Keskel jaanilõke, esiplaanil kaks lõõtspillimängijat ja rahvariietes tantsupaar, nende taga teised tantsijad. Vasakul pildi keskel vägikaikavedu, paremal alumises nurgas kaks istuvat vanameest (üks neist piibuga). Vanameeste taga vestlevad kaks naist ja üks mees. Foonil öine mets. Rohekashall koloriit peegelduvate tulehelkidega. Paremal kiikujad.
913.de: A folk festival scene. In the centre a midsummer bonfire, in the foreground two accordion players and a dancing couple in folk costume, other dancers behind them. On the left in the middle of the picture a tug-of-war, on the right in the lower corner two seated old men (one of them with a pipe). Behind the old men two women and a man conversing. In the background a nocturnal forest. Greenish-grey colouring with reflecting glimmers of fire. On the right, people on swings.

916.d: Kubistlik ühe silma ja mustade vuntsidega mehe portree otsevaates. Intensiivsed punased ja tumesinised värvid.
916.de: Cubist frontal portrait of a man with one eye and a black moustache. Intense red and dark blue colours.

3035.d: Skulptuur kujutab Fr. R. Kreutzwaldi seismas, paremas käes raamat, vasak tõstetud lõua juurde. Kujul kujutatud seljas eest lahti pikk kuub, ees nööbid. Kuju seisab kandilisel alusel. Alusel vasaku jala taga autori nimetähed JR ja aastaarv 1958-59. Valge kipsist kuju kokku pandud 2 osast: alumise osa moodustavad alus ja keha alumine pool keskkohani ja ülemise osa moodustab keskkohast keha ülemine pool.
3035.de: The sculpture depicts Fr. R. Kreutzwald standing, a book in his right hand, his left hand raised to his chin. The figure is depicted wearing a long open coat in front, with buttons in front. The figure stands on a rectangular base. On the base, behind the left foot, the author's initials JR and the year 1958-59. The white plaster figure is assembled from 2 parts: the lower part forms the base and the lower half of the body up to the middle, and the upper part forms the upper half of the body from the middle up.

3221.d: Panoraamne mägimaastik: Taamal karmiilmeline mäestik, keskel järv või fjörd, mida kahelt poolt piiravad järskude veerudega mäed. Esiplaanil laineline klibuline mäenõlv, all paremas nurgas kahe kaabuga mehe pea- ja rinnaosa, vasakpoolsel mehel õlal pikk kepp. Ülaservas pilveriba, mille lõikavad läbi kahel pool fjordi paiknevate mägede tipud. Mäetippude vahel ülal hallikassinine taevas. Maalitud peamiselt roosades, ookri- ja sinakasrohelistes toonides.
3221.de: A panoramic mountain landscape: in the distance, a harsh-looking mountain range, in the middle a lake or fjord bordered on both sides by mountains with steep slopes. In the foreground, a wavy, pebbly mountain slope, in the lower right corner the head and chest of two men wearing hats, the man on the left with a long stick on his shoulder. At the top edge, a strip of clouds cut through by the peaks of the mountains situated on either side of the fjord. Between the mountain peaks above, a greyish-blue sky. Painted mainly in pink, ochre and bluish-green tones.

3293.d: Visandlikult maalitud kompositsioon kahe figuuri ning nende taga oleva aknaga. Maali vasakul serval asetsev poolfiguur on maalitud otsevaates. Lugevas asendis, veidi paremale pööratud pea nõjutamas käele. Esiplaanil keskel, veidi vasakul asetsev poolfiguur on profiilis, suunaga paremale, õlani paljastatud parem käsi toetab pead. Vasak on ette lauale sirutatud. Aknapind jääb põhiosas maali paremasse ülapoolde. Aknast on näha aimatavaid puu- ja maastikukontuure. Maali koloriidi moodustavad tugevad roosad-rohelised toonid. Figuuride rõivad on valged, markeeritud rohelisega. Kitsas laud kahe figuuri vahel on hele: rohekas-valge. Ruumi osa on ookerjaspruun. Aknapind roosa.
3293.de: A sketch-like composition of two figures with a window behind them. The half-figure at the left edge of the painting is painted in a frontal view. In a reading pose, the head turned slightly to the right, resting on the hand. The half-figure in the foreground, in the centre, slightly to the left, is in profile, facing right, the right hand, bared to the shoulder, supports the head. The left is stretched forward onto the table. The window surface mainly occupies the upper right part of the painting. Through the window, indistinct outlines of trees and landscape can be discerned. The colouring of the painting consists of strong pink-green tones. The figures' clothing is white, marked with green. The narrow table between the two figures is light: greenish-white. The part of the room is ochre-brown. The window surface is pink.

3783.de: On a square table a light-coloured bust of a woman, a white jug, books, two red plates.

3804.d: Kesksel alusel mandoliin, punakas pruun kauss kahe puuviljaga ja kõrge piklik vaas. Paremal foonil hele, esemete all sinine riie. Foonil vasemal värvilistest nelinurkadest mosaiikne pind.
3804.de: On a central stand a mandolin, a reddish brown bowl with two pieces of fruit and a tall elongated vase. On the right background, light, under the objects a blue cloth. On the left background a mosaic-like surface of coloured rectangles.

3808.d: Esiplaanil tanum rohelise karjaväravaga, kiviaedadega tükeldatud põllu- ja heinamaalapid. Silmapiiril rookatustega talumajad ja põlispuud nende vahel. Ülal pilvitu erksinine taevas. Rohekas üldkoloriit, kohati selgesti eristatavad pikad pintslitõmbed.
3808.de: In the foreground, a homestead with a green farm gate, patches of field and meadow divided by stone fences. On the horizon, thatched-roof farmhouses and ancient trees between them. Above, a cloudless bright blue sky. Overall greenish colouring, in places clearly distinguishable long brushstrokes.

3809.d: Esiplaanil tumedas seelikus, tumedas mustrilises pluusis istuv naine, roheline rätik õlgadel. Pluusi kaeluses pross, peas beež kübar, nägu selle all heledasti valgustatud. Naisest paremal, aknalaual, triibulisel linal hele vaas värviliste puuviljadega. Vasakul triibulised kardinad, foonil aken vaatega helesinisele taevale ja linnale.
3809.de: In the foreground a woman sitting in a dark skirt and dark patterned blouse, a green shawl on her shoulders. A brooch at the blouse's neckline, a beige hat on her head, her face brightly lit beneath it. To the woman's right, on a windowsill, on a striped cloth, a light-coloured vase with colourful fruits. On the left striped curtains, in the background a window with a view of a light blue sky and the city.

3821.d: Peamiselt tuhmides rohelistes, sinistes ja hallides toonides maastik kaarduva kiviaiaga esiplaanil paremal ja pukktuulikuga keskel. Tuuliku taga paremal mustaks küntud põld, vasakul tee, mis viib pildi sügavuses asuva külani. Silmapiiril asetsevad vaheldumisi küla moodustanud talumajad ja puud. Ülal kollakashall taevas.
3821.de: A landscape mainly in muted green, blue and grey tones, with a curving stone fence in the foreground at right and a post mill in the centre. Behind the mill at right, a field ploughed black, at left a road leading to a village in the depth of the picture. On the horizon, farmhouses and trees forming the village alternate. Above, a yellowish-grey sky.

3830.d: Esiplaanil põõsad väikeste punaste marjadega. Tagaplaanil puud ja taevas.
3830.de: In the foreground bushes with small red berries. In the background trees and sky.

3831.d: Esiplaanil frontaalselt alla minev väike trepp ja pildi sügavusse suunduv kõrgete puudega ääristatud tee. Läbi raagus puude paistavad majad. Maa kaetud osaliselt kerge lumega.
3831.de: In the foreground, a small staircase descending frontally and a road bordered by tall trees leading into the depth of the picture. Houses visible through bare trees. The ground partially covered with a light layer of snow.

3832.d: Esiplaanil lage vesi. Tagapool kaks väikest saart puudega. Eemalt paistab sinakas metsaga kallas.
3832.de: In the foreground open water. Further back two small islands with trees. In the distance a bluish shore with forest is visible.

3834.d: Ruumi sisevaade. Vasakul esiplaanil Lenin, tagapool laua taga Stalin. Paremal rühm mehi relvadega, osa sõduririietuses.
3834.de: Interior view of a room. On the left in the foreground Lenin, behind him Stalin at a table. On the right a group of men with weapons, some in soldiers' uniforms.

3853.d: Ruumi sisevaade; vasakul laua ääres istub mees, vasakus käes avatud raamat, paremaga toetub lauale. Paremal seisab mees, käes pintsel ja palett.
3853.de: Interior view of a room; on the left a man sits at the table, in his left hand an open book, with the right he leans on the table. On the right stands a man, holding a brush and palette.

3867.d: Esiplaanil paremas ääres soniga mehe poolfiguur ning osa majast. Vasakul pikad müügilauad juurviljadega ning müüjad ja ostjad. Tagaplaanil linna hooned.
3867.de: In the foreground on the right edge the half-figure of a man with a cane and part of a house. On the left long sales tables with vegetables, and sellers and buyers. In the background city buildings.

3868.d: Tumedal foonil punases laiaäärse kübaraga, mõtliku ilmega naise istuv poolfiguur; kerge pöördega paremale. Käed asetatud vaheliti rinnale; õlgadel hele triibuline jakk.
3868.de: On a dark background a seated half-figure of a pensive-looking woman in red, in a wide-brimmed hat; with a slight turn to the right. Hands placed crossed on the chest; on the shoulders a light striped jacket.

3882.d: Raamaturiiuli ees istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur poolpöördes, üks käsi puusas, teine põlvel, lillakassinine särk küünarnukini üleskeeratud käistega, kaelus avatud, helehallid püksid, tumedad juuksed, kõrge laup, sirge nina.
3882.de: Three-quarter figure of a man sitting in front of a bookshelf, in a half-turn, one hand on his hip, the other on his knee, a purplish-blue shirt with sleeves rolled up to the elbow, collar open, light-grey trousers, dark hair, high forehead, straight nose.

3884.d: Suur figuraalne kompositsioon. Esiplaanil viljakottide juures seisvad pearätikutes naised, ühel neist märkmik ja punane pliiats käes. Keskplaanil paremal viljapeksumasin, millel kolm inimest, kelle kätte jangub mees hobusekoormalt viljavihke. Kaks meest koguvad vilja kottidesse. Keskplaanil vasakul sinises kleidis ja pearätikus naine seljaga vaataja poole hangule toetumas. Temast vasakul kaal viljakottidega ja mehed viljakotte autole laadimas. Tagaplaanil õlekuhi, vasakul ja paremal maastik.
3884.de: A large figural composition. In the foreground, women in headscarves standing by grain sacks, one of them holding a notebook and a red pencil. In the middle ground on the right a threshing machine, at which three people are handing sheaves of grain to a man from a horse-drawn load. Two men are collecting grain into sacks. In the middle ground on the left a woman in a blue dress and headscarf, with her back to the viewer, leaning on a pitchfork. To her left a scale with grain sacks and men loading grain sacks onto a truck. In the background a haystack, landscape to the left and right.

3886.d: Esiplaanil roheline maapind, millel kerge pintslitõmbega visandatud looklev teerada. Vasakule jäävad kõrged kadakad ja põõsad ning paremale põõsad. Madalamal keskplaanil metsa ja natukene näha merd. Taevas hallikaid pilvi. Etüüdilikult maalitud.
3886.de: In the foreground a green ground on which a winding path is sketched with a light brush stroke. To the left are tall junipers and bushes, and to the right, bushes. Lower in the middle ground, forest and a bit of the sea can be seen. In the sky, grayish clouds. Painted in an etude-like manner.

3966.d: Ees tee ja põõsad, paremal üksikud kuused. Keskel madalik, millel üksik põõsas. Kaugemal künklik maastik. Tagaplaanil taevas. Läbi udu paistavad tähed ja kuu.
3966.de: In front a road and bushes, on the right solitary spruces. In the middle a lowland with a solitary bush. Farther away a hilly landscape. In the background the sky. Through the mist stars and the moon can be seen.

The middle picture is a half-title for canto XIX of "Kalevipoeg". In the foreground a man sits, on the right two seated women. Behind them, couples dancing. At the end of a pole, a tar barrel is burning. In the third picture, a man lies on the ground, arms crossed on his chest. Beside him stands a woman.

Vasakpoolsel alumisel pildil päisliist XII loole. Sild, mida uhuvad lained. Parempoolsel ülemisel pildil vinjett XV loole. Esiplaanil kivid, tagaplaanil põlev taluhoone. Parempoolsel teisel pildil vinjett järelsõnale. Esiplaanil Kalevipoeg, rinnaportree, profiil paremale. Paremalt kolmas pilt vinjett sissejuhatusele. Esiplaanil osa puust üksikute harudega
4107.de: 8 pictures on the sheet. In the upper left picture, a header strip for the afterword. In the foreground a stone wall, on the right a tree. In the background the roof of a house. In the background a few trees. The second picture from the left, a header strip for the introduction. In the foreground a sacrificial stone with three holes, smoke rising from the middle one. The third picture from the left, a header strip for Tale I. In the foreground a thick tree. In the background a full moon. In the lower left picture, a header strip for Tale XII. A bridge being washed by waves. In the upper right picture, a vignette for Tale XV. In the foreground stones, in the background a burning farmhouse. In the second picture on the right, a vignette for the afterword. In the foreground Kalevipoeg, a bust portrait, profile facing right. The third picture from the right, a vignette for the introduction. In the foreground part of a tree with individual branches

All vasakul L-kujuline motiiv lapergustest ümarvormidest, all paremal horisontaalne, piklik motiiv kolmnurkadest. Taust allosas horisontaalsetest ja ülal vertikaalsetest joontest

The background consists of horizontal lines in the lower part and vertical lines above.

4680.dm: kujutise laius: 18.8 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 19.1 cm
4680.d: Poolfiguuridena kujutatud kaabuga mees ja pearätiga naine ning vankri ette rakendatud hobuse pea – Andres ja Krõõt teel Vargamäele. Inimesed on tõsiste, isegi süngete nägudega, taust hele, kujunditeta (soomaastik?), vaid vasakul alumises nurgas pisut puulatvu.
4680.de: A man with a hat and a woman with a headscarf depicted in half-figure, and the head of a horse harnessed to a cart – Andres and Krõõt on their way to Vargamäe. The people have serious, even grim faces, the background is light, without figures (a bog landscape?), only a bit of treetops in the lower left corner.

4681.dm: kujutise laius: 11.3 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 15.9 cm

4682.de: In the centre of the picture is the half-frontal full figure of a man prying up stones - a thick pole raised in his hands above his head; in the foreground are large stones and on the horizon a horse grazing grass, behind it a watery marsh landscape

4683.dm: kujutise laius: 11.5 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 15.9 cm

4683.de: : Two men depicted as half-figures standing chest to chest facing each other. The taller man on the left wearing a hat is evidently Andres, while the man on the right with a sullen expression in a peaked cap is evidently Pearu

4684.dm: kujutise laius: 11.4 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 15.9 cm
4684.d: Pildi keskmes on poolselgvaates noor hobusesabasoenguga noor naine, imik süles ja kolm põrsast jalgade ümber; tema kõrval on viljapäid ja jupike karjaaeda, taamal paistavad mõned puud ja pikk taluhoone
4684.de: The center of the picture shows, in half profile, a young woman with a ponytail hairstyle, an infant in her lap, and three piglets around her feet; beside her are grain ears and a bit of pasture fence, in the distance some trees and a long farmhouse can be seen

4685.dm: kujutise laius: 11.4 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 15.9 cm
4685.d: Andrest on kujutatud laua taga istumas, avatud Piibel käes ja vaatamas tõsisel ilmel otse enda ette; laua ees paistab talupingi nurk, laua taga on näha voodi ots; stseeni valgustab petrooleumilamp laual, mis heidab seintele voodi ja Andrese kogu tumedaid tontlikke varje
4685.de: Andres is depicted sitting at a table, an open Bible in his hand, looking straight ahead with a serious expression; before the table the corner of a peasant bench is visible, behind the table the end of a bed can be seen; the scene is lit by a kerosene lamp on the table, which casts dark, ghostly shadows of the bed and Andres's figure onto the walls

4686.dm: kujutise laius: 11.4 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 15.9 cm

4688.de: Woman and man in a sitting position - the woman resting her head against the man's chest, the man pulling the flap of a fur coat over the woman; a melancholy mood

4689.dm: kujutise laius: 11.4 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 16.0 cm

4689.de: Scene at Krõõt's sickbed – the sick woman lies in bed, her head propped up higher on the pillow, the bathhouse woman Mari bends over her, Andres sits deep in thought at the foot of the bed, in the foreground, in clear view, a small girl

4690.dm: kujutise laius: 11.4 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 15.9 cm

4690.de: Tiit Hundipalu giving his godson Indrek a blessing before he goes to the city for school; the man with the powerful beard, depicted in side view, is putting his arm around the shoulders of the boy standing with a bundle in his hand; in the foreground, shown in full front view as a half-figure, is Andres with his head lowered, behind him Mari in a headscarf

Her light oval face is framed by long brown hair combed back. Eyes closed, mouth closed like a dot. Under the woman's green jacket a reddish-brown dress with a wide décolleté. Bluish-green mottled light background. Painted with a wide brush, expressive painting style.

6127.d: Tumedas riides, tumedas peakattes noore naise pisut hirmul kahvatu nägu otsevaates. Tumedad silmad, paokil punane suu. Taustal aimatav öine linnamaastik tuledega. Tume gamma, lühike närviline pintslikiri.
6127.de: The slightly frightened pale face, in frontal view, of a young woman in dark clothing and dark headwear. Dark eyes, red mouth slightly open. In the background a barely discernible night cityscape with lights. Dark colour range, short nervous brushwork.

6128.d: Ümaranäolise nöpsninaga tüdruku portree veerandpöördes paremale. Pisut pruntis suu, tumedad silmad sirgete kulmude all, juuksed ülepea kammitud soengus. Roosakas heleda kraega kleit seljas. Nägu maalitud türkiissiniste markeerivate joontega, tekitades rambivalguse illusiooni.
6128.de: Portrait of a round-faced, snub-nosed girl, in a three-quarter turn to the right. A slightly pouting mouth, dark eyes under straight eyebrows, hair combed back in a style over the head. She wears a pinkish dress with a light-coloured collar. The face is painted with turquoise-blue marking lines, creating the illusion of footlight illumination.

6129.d: Tumedapäine lühikese soenguga tumedasilmne tüdruk istumas heledas ruumis poolpöördes vasakule, käed süles. Tüdrukul unistav pilk. Seljas sirge kaelusega, kolmveerand varrukatega erkroosa pluus. Õhuline, impressionistlik pintslikiri.
6129.de: A dark-haired girl with dark eyes and a short hairstyle, sitting in a light room in a half-turn to the left, hands in her lap. The girl has a dreamy gaze. Wearing a bright pink blouse with a straight collar and three-quarter sleeves. Airy, impressionistic brushwork.

6130.d: Heleda sinkja joonega markeeritud naisenäo taustal esiplaanil mustad risti-rästijooned (puutüved). Vasakul allnurgas kollaste õitega oks ja lennul pääsulind.
6130.de: Against a background of a woman's face marked with a light bluish line, black criss-crossing lines (tree trunks) in the foreground. At the lower left corner a branch with yellow blossoms and a swallow in flight.

6131.d: Hallipäise vanema naise poolfiguur käsipõsakil toetumas aiale, murelik pilk vaatajale suunatud. Taustal ja vasakul lopsakas roheluses aiad
6131.de: Half-figure of an elderly grey-haired woman, chin resting on her hand, leaning against a fence, with a worried gaze directed at the viewer. In the background and on the left lush green gardens.

6233.d: Sombus-halli taeva all avar sügisene maastik veekoguga. Esiplaanil vasakul lillakaspruun küntud põld. Põlluveerel paremal looklev tee, sellel kaks naisfiguuri istumas.
6233.de: Under a gloomy grey sky an expansive autumn landscape with a body of water. In the foreground on the left a purplish-brown ploughed field. At the edge of the field on the right a winding road, on which two female figures are sitting.

6241.d: Kõrgete kallaste vahel voolav kivise sängiga jõgi. Vasakul servas kaheksa hobust. Paremal kaldaserv lehtpuudega ja põõsastega.
6241.de: A river with a stony bed flowing between high banks. On the left edge eight horses. On the right the bank edge with deciduous trees and bushes.

6247.d: Kaks halli kala pruunil laual, milledest esimene katki lõigatud ja punane mari paistab. Tagapool kauss.
6247.de: Two grey fish on a brown table, the first of which is cut open and a red roe can be seen. Behind, a bowl.

6249.d: Diagonaalselt vasakult paremale sõitev paat kümne mehega. Paremal ülanurgas näha tükk punakat
6249.de: A boat with ten men sailing diagonally from left to right. In the upper right corner a piece of reddish [is visible].

6250.d: Esiplaanil tänaval, paralleelselt tornide reaga, ruttavad inimesed. Vasakul seisvate autode tagant, vanade puumajade tagant, paistab elektrijaama korsten, keskel Oleviste kiriku torn.
6250.de: In the foreground on the street, parallel to a row of towers, people are hurrying. Behind the parked cars on the left, behind old wooden houses, the chimney of a power plant is visible, in the middle the tower of St Olaf's Church.

6252.d: Rutja. Esiplaanil kivise kaldaga jõgi. Paremalt maanteetamm ja sillapostide rida suunaga metsa poole. Kaugemal männimets, põõsastik. Metsa ja kalda vahelisel maaribal inimesed heina rõngu panemas. Taevas süngelt pilves.
6252.de: Rutja. In the foreground a river with a stony bank. On the right a roadway embankment and a row of bridge posts leading towards the forest. Further away a pine forest, shrubbery. On the strip of land between the forest and the bank people making hay bundles. The sky darkly overcast.

6255.de: A field in the foreground, a forest visible behind.

6256.d: Esiplaanil vaataja suunas voolav oja jäätükkidega. Kallastel tükati lund. Tagaplaanil segamets kuuskedega, mis varjab silmapiiri.
6256.de: In the foreground a stream flowing towards the viewer with pieces of ice. On the banks patches of snow. In the background a mixed forest with spruces obscuring the horizon.

6257.d: Esiplaanil väike riba kallast ja jõgi paatidega. Paremal meri ja eemalt paistev Tallinna siluett. Vasakul lipumast punase lipuga ja hooned ning puud.
6257.de: In the foreground a small strip of shore and a river with boats. On the right the sea and, visible from a distance, the silhouette of Tallinn. On the left a flagpole with a red flag, and buildings and trees.

6258.d: Jõeorg kõrgete kallastega vasakul ja parema, millel mets. Esiplaanil vasakul madalal luhal lehmad söömas. Paremal jõele ehitatud tamm.
6258.de: River valley with high banks on the left and on the right, the latter with forest. In the foreground on the left, on a low water-meadow, cows grazing. On the right a dam built on the river.

6259.d: Suur järv rohkete saartega. Paremal kallas kõrgete kaljurahnudega, millel kasvamas üksikud männid. Samuti vasakul kaljune kallas mändide ja kaskedega. Kõrge silmapiir. Järvel laev palgiparvega.
6259.de: A large lake with numerous islands. On the right a shore with tall boulder rocks, on which single pine trees are growing. Likewise on the left a rocky shore with pines and birches. High horizon. On the lake a ship with a log raft.

6260.d: Esiplaanil paremal mägisel maastikul kivide vahel valged kitsed. Sellest vasakul üksikute puudega mägi. Tagaplaanil kõrged mäed, mille tipud ulatuvad pilvedesse.
6260.de: In the foreground on the right, white goats among rocks on a mountainous landscape. To the left of it, a mountain with solitary trees. In the background, high mountains whose peaks reach into the clouds.

6261.d: Esiplaanil oja, mille kaldal vasakul spinninguga õngitsev mees, seisvas asendis, profiilis paremale. Oja käänaku kohal üksik suur kivi vees. Parempoolne tõusev kallas kaetud tiheda põõsastikuga. Maali keskosas teisel pool kallast küün. Pilvine taevas.
6261.de: In the foreground, a stream, on whose bank on the left a man is fishing with a spinning rod, standing, in profile to the right. Above a bend in the stream, a single large stone in the water. The rising bank on the right is covered with dense bushes. In the middle part of the painting, on the other side of the bank, a barn. Cloudy sky.

6262.d: Lumise maastiku keskel tee, viis last. Paremal, metsatukk. Taga vasakul hooned. Piki teed vasakul telefonipost.
6262.de: In the middle of a snowy landscape a road, five children. On the right a small patch of forest. In the background on the left buildings. Along the road on the left a telephone pole.

6263.d: Ees vasakul kahe suure kivi vahel kolm last tule juures. Kaugemal keskelt paremale must-valget tõugu kari metsa ääres söömas. Pilvine taevas.
6263.de: In the foreground on the left, between two large stones, three children by a fire. Further away, from the centre to the right, a black-and-white herd grazing by the edge of a forest. Cloudy sky.

6264.d: Esiplaanil niitmata, tagapool niidetud põld. Põldude  keskel, pildi keskel tumeroheline põõsas. Taustal üksikuid puid ja hooneid. Nende taga mets. Kõrge hallikas taevas.
6264.de: In the foreground an unmown field, behind it a mown field. In the middle of the fields, in the middle of the picture, a dark green bush. In the background solitary trees and buildings. Behind them a forest. A high, greyish sky.

6265.d: Esiplaanil kahe laudsilla vahel veekogu. Vasakul silla lähedal kalapaat kaluriga. Temast vasakul seisab sillal mees, käes kalavõrk. Kaldal, kahe silla vahel, mootorpaat. Taamal kolme kuuri juures inimesed askeldamas. Taevas pilvine.
6265.de: In the foreground a body of water between two plank bridges. On the left, near the bridge, a fishing boat with a fisherman. To his left a man stands on the bridge, holding a fishing net. On the shore, between the two bridges, a motorboat. Further off, people busy near three sheds. Cloudy sky.

6266.d: Vasakul keskaegsete majade taga, Tallinna raekoja punane katus torniga. Majade taga vasakul Pühavaimu kiriku torn. Esiplaanil Harju väljak jalutajatega.
6266.de: On the left, behind medieval houses, the red roof with tower of Tallinn Town Hall. Behind the houses on the left the tower of the Church of the Holy Spirit. In the foreground Harju Square with strollers.

6267.d: Peaaegu maali keskel oleva palkidest ehitatud, rohelise loosungiga ehitud värava taga paremal, keset veiste karja, askeldamas neljast inimesest koosev grupp. Nende taga paremal ajavad kaks naist kaht lehma (üks punane, teine valge) sindlikatusega kivilauta. Värava taga vasakul selgvaates sinise rätikuga naine ja tema kõrval vasakul lehm. Värava ees vasakul, raagus kase all, kaks tütarlast lüpsikutega. Paremal veab naine kettipidi lehma. Lehmast paremal kaabuga mees, piibuga paremas käes. Nende taga näha osaliselt punast lehma, valget hobust, kelle päitseid hoiab mõlema käega kinni nokkmütsiga mees. Taamal männiokste varjus, heinakuhja otsas, tõstavad kaks meest heina lakka. Heina võtab lakas
6267.de: Almost in the middle of the painting, behind a gate built of logs and decorated with a green slogan banner, on the right, amid a herd of cattle, a group of four people busy at work. Behind them on the right two women are driving two cows (one red, the other white) toward a stone barn with a shingle roof. Behind the gate on the left, in full view, a woman with a blue kerchief, and beside her on the left a cow. In front of the gate on the left, under a bare birch, two girls with milk pails. On the right a woman is leading a cow by a chain. To the right of the cow a man in a hat, with a pipe in his right hand. Behind them a red cow is partly visible, as well as a white horse whose halter is held with both hands by a man in a peaked cap. In the distance, in the shade of pine branches, on top of a haystack, two men are lifting hay onto the stack. Hay is being taken on the stack

6268.d: Esiplaanil paremal kaares tahapoole suunduva süvendamisel oleva oja (või magistraalkraavi) kummalgi kaldal ekskavaator töös, parempoolsel kopp alla lastud, vasakpoolsel üleval. Vasakul kaldal kuus inimfiguuri, neist üks naine, kellede olekust ilmneb seotust tööprotsessiga - käes plaan, mille järgi uuritakse ümbrust. Üks töömees labidaga, teine teiba ja kirvega. Tagapool vesine madalik hõredate puudega.
6268.de: In the foreground on the right, on both banks of a stream (or main drainage ditch) being deepened and curving backward, an excavator is at work, on the right one with its bucket lowered, on the left one raised. On the left bank six human figures, one of them a woman, whose actions show they are involved in the work process - one holds a plan, according to which the surroundings are being examined. One workman with a shovel, another with a pole and an axe. Further back a watery lowland with sparse trees.

6270.d: Esialal vasakul rannaliival suuri lõhesid ja suuri kalakaste. Keskel kaldale uhutud kalapaat täis kalu. Paadi juures askeldamas mehi ja naisi. Tagapool vasakul täidetud kalakastide taga, kuivanud võrke, paremal paadisillal kalapüügi vahendeid, sillast tagapool asetsevat paati tõmbab mees merre tõmbamas. Taga vasakul metsane rand ja paremal avameri.
6270.de: In the foreground on the left, on the beach sand, large salmon and large fish crates. In the middle, a fishing boat full of fish washed up on the shore. Men and women busying themselves by the boat. Further back on the left, behind filled fish crates, dried nets; on the right on a jetty, fishing implements; behind the jetty a man is pulling a boat into the sea. Further back on the left a forested shore and on the right the open sea.

6281.d: Pikajuukseline blond naisakt külgvaates kollasetriibulisel kušetil  istumas, kuivatuslina kätel, pesukauss ees põrandal. Ümbritseb tubane interjöör: paremal kollane kapp, ümar lauake vaasiga, taga roosatriibuline sirm, vasakul rohekad kardinad. Pastelsed roosad-rohelised toonid, valgus-varjuga modelleeriv maalilaad.
6281.de: A long-haired blonde female nude in side view, sitting on a yellow-striped chaise longue, a towel in her hands, a washbasin in front on the floor. Surrounded by an indoor interior: on the right a yellow cabinet, a round little table with a vase, behind it a pink-striped screen, on the left greenish curtains. Pastel pink-green tones, a painting style modelling with light and shadow.

6283.d: Ruumilise mõjuga värvikas kompositsioon, valdavalt rohekassinistest, kollakaist sfäärilistest, koonilistest üksteisesse rulluvatest ja lõikuvatest kujunditest.
6283.de: A spatially effective, colourful composition, predominantly of greenish-blue, yellowish spherical and conical shapes rolling into and intersecting one another.

6286.d: Keskel kahel helesinisel padjal lamav noor naine. Naisel mahagonikarva juuksed, selga paljaks jättev roosa-mustakirju kleit, jalad risti, käed põlvedel, vasakus käes punaste kaantega raamat, pilk suunatud vaatajale. Voodi ees ümmargune madal laud, millel pruun sangaga keraamiline nõu. Foon läbi maalitud tihedate pintslilöökidega, valdavalt sinakashallides toonides.
6286.de: In the centre, a young woman lying on two light blue pillows. The woman has mahogany-coloured hair, wears a pink-and-black patterned dress that leaves her back bare, legs crossed, hands on knees, in her left hand a book with red covers, gaze directed at the viewer. In front of the bed a round low table on which a brown ceramic vessel with a handle. The background is painted through with dense brushstrokes, mainly in bluish-grey tones.

6291.d: Keskel, suures kollases tugitoolis, istub kollaste sirgete juustega naine, mõlemad käed toolileenil puhkamas. Naisel seljas helesinine, ülalt mustade triipude, seelikuosas mustade täppidega kleit. Foonil, otse naise selja taga roheline nelinurk, ülejäänud foon mitut tooni lilla. Kohati vormi musta kontuuriga rõhutatud.
6291.de: In the middle, in a large yellow armchair, sits a woman with yellow straight hair, both hands resting on the arms of the chair. The woman is wearing a light blue dress with black stripes at the top and black dots on the skirt part. In the background, directly behind the woman's back, a green rectangle, the rest of the background in several shades of purple. In places the form is emphasised with a black contour.

6292.d: Peenemustrilises, mustades-valgetes toonides kleidis priskete roosade käsivartega noor  naine diivanil istumas. Naisel pikk sirge nina, pisut viltused silmad ja pikad tumepruunid juuksed. Naisel süles must kass. Foon ülaosas halliruuduline, all helesinine. Maalitud peene pintsliga.
6292.de: A young woman in a finely patterned black-and-white dress with plump pink arms sitting on a sofa. The woman has a long straight nose, slightly slanted eyes and long dark brown hair. On the woman's lap a black cat. The background is grey-checked at the top, light blue below. Painted with a fine brush.

6293.d: Kompositsiooni keskpunktis teineteist embavad mees ja naine. Mehel seljas must ülikond, naisel veinpunane kleit. Fooniks olevas interjööris, armastajapaarist paremal, valge lina, pudelite ja karahvinidega täidetud laud. Laua kohal seinal kübaraga daami portree. Figuuridest vasakul voodi,  viimase taga raadio ning kirjude lillade kardinatega piiratud aken. Interjööris palju valgust ja helke.
6293.de: At the centre of the composition a man and a woman embracing each other. The man wears a black suit, the woman a wine-red dress. In the background interior, to the right of the pair of lovers, a table with a white cloth, covered with bottles and carafes. Above the table on the wall a portrait of a lady with a hat. To the left of the figures a bed, behind it a radio and a window bordered with colourful lilac curtains. The interior is full of light and reflections.

6294.d: Hallikasrohelisel foonil noore, tumedajuukselise neiu büst. Neiul pikad lokkis juuksed, punakas kübar, triibulise rinnaesisega, täpiliste varrukatega hall kleit. Vaade silmanurgast. Valgust ja helke üle kogu figuuri.
6294.de: On a greyish-green background, the bust of a young, dark-haired girl. The girl has long curly hair, a reddish hat, a grey dress with a striped front and dotted sleeves. Viewed from the corner of the eye. Light and reflections over the whole figure.

6390.d: Sinise- ja valgetriibulises kleidis istuva tütarlapse poolfiguur otsevaates. Vasakul laual lebav käsi.
6390.de: Half-figure of a girl sitting in a blue and white striped dress, in frontal view. On the left a hand lying on the table.

6391.d: Naise rindportree otsevaates. Juuksed taga kammitud, prillid. Tume rõivastus.
6391.de: Frontal bust portrait of a woman. Hair combed back, glasses. Dark clothing.

6410.d: Esiplaanil põlluriba, tagapool põõsad, puud ja kiviaiad. Eemalt paistab sile merepind.
6410.de: In the foreground a strip of field, behind it bushes, trees and stone fences. In the distance a smooth sea surface is visible.

6411.d: Kahe noore naise rinnaportree otsevaates. Vasakpoolne pruunijuukseline, suurte selgete tumepruunide silmadega. Parempoolne kollakate juustega, sinakashallide silmade pilk suunatud vasakule. Rõivas mõlemal pruunikas-lillakas, parempoolsel kleidi all helesinine pluus. Foon soelilla.
6411.de: Frontal bust portrait of two young women. The left one is brown-haired, with large clear dark brown eyes. The right one has yellowish hair, her bluish-grey eyes' gaze directed to the left. Both wear brownish-purple clothing, the right one has a light blue blouse under her dress. Background is a warm purple.

6413.d: Tumedapäise ja tumedasilmse keskealise naise otsevaates istuv kolmveerandfiguur triibulise draperii taustal. Seljas roheline jakk ja hele seelik, vasak käsi süles, parem toetub sinisele alusele. Fooni vasakus nurgas kahvatukollane riba.
6413.de: Sitting three-quarter figure of a dark-haired, dark-eyed middle-aged woman shown frontally against a background of striped drapery. Wearing a green jacket and a light-coloured skirt, left hand in her lap, right hand resting on a blue support. In the left corner of the background a pale yellow strip.

6419.d: Noore naise rindportree otsevaates, juuksed kuklasse kammitud, sinise jaki avatud kaeluse alt paistab kollane pluus. Hele foon.
6419.de: Bust portrait of a young woman in frontal view, hair combed back, a yellow blouse visible under the open collar of a blue jacket. Light background.

6454.d: Punasel alusel tünnikujuline valge vaas suure kimbu kirevate lilledega (moonid, käokannid jt.). Taustal interjöör aknanurgaga vasakul.
6454.de: Barrel-shaped white vase on a red base with a large bouquet of colourful flowers (poppies, columbines, etc.). Background an interior with a window corner on the left.

6455.d: Kompositsioon figuuridst interjööris rippuva maali ees. Taustal laias kuldraamis pildi parem alumine nurk ja alumine osa, millel kujutatud ristpuul rippuva Krisyuse kahvatud jalad. Pildi ees veidi kühmus punapäise habemega mehe rinnafiguur otsevaates, pilk alla suunatud. Mehel smaragdroheline riietus. Valdavalt roostepruunid toonid, maaliline käsitlus.
6455.de: Composition of figures in an interior in front of a hanging painting. In the background, in a wide gilded frame, the lower right corner and lower part of the picture, depicting the pale feet of Christ hanging on the cross beam. In front of the picture, a slightly stooped bust of a red-bearded man, frontal view, gaze directed downward. The man wears emerald green clothing. Predominantly rust-brown tones, painterly treatment.

6456.d: Aknast välja vaatav mees on maalitud tumedais, pruunikais-hallikais toonides. Pruun kardin varjab osa figuurist. Aknalaual on õitsva hüatsindiga lillepott. Mehe seljataga on näha veidi toa sisustust: kirju vaip, pruun tool. Mehe parem käsi toetub aknalauale.
6456.de: A man looking out of a window is painted in dark, brownish-grayish tones. A brown curtain conceals part of the figure. On the windowsill is a flowerpot with a blooming hyacinth. Behind the man, part of the room's furnishings can be seen: a patterned rug, a brown chair. The man's right hand rests on the windowsill.

6462.d: Pilvelõhkujate ja tuledes linna taustal noore ema (madonna) poolfiguur mähkmeis sülelapsega, ulatamas talle revolvrit. Naise pea kaetud kollase rätiga, õlgadel punane rüü. Ekspressiivne laad, musta kontuuriga vorme rõhutav.
6462.de: Against the backdrop of a city of skyscrapers and lights, half-figure of a young mother (madonna) with a swaddled infant in her arms, handing it a revolver. The woman's head covered with a yellow shawl, a red robe on her shoulders. Expressive manner, emphasising forms with black contour.

6465.d: Noore, õlgadeni ulatuvate blondide juustega naise rindportree kerges pöördes paremale. Valge kaelus, roosakas jakk. Tume rohekas-sinine foon.
6465.de: Bust portrait of a young woman with blonde shoulder-length hair, in a slight turn to the right. White collar, pinkish jacket. Dark greenish-blue background.

6497.d: Noore tütarlapse põlvportree toolil istumas, käed vaheliti süles, peapööre vasakule. Seljas valge pluus ja kirju vest.
6497.de: Knee-length portrait of a young girl sitting on a chair, hands folded in her lap, head turned to the left. Wearing a white blouse and a patterned waistcoat.

6530.d: Esiplaanil veepinnal paadisilla juures paremal sinakashall mootorpaat, selle taga näha kaks vestlevat meest. Silla peal keset maali kolmest mehest koosnev inimgrupp, nende taga paremal paadi sees üksik mees. Vasakul kaldal heleda vooderdusega maja ots ja kõrged lehtpuud. Taamal sild ja sellest paremal kolmemastiline purjekas.
6530.de: In the foreground on the water's surface by the boat pier on the right a bluish-grey motorboat, behind it two conversing men can be seen. On the pier in the middle of the painting a group of three men, behind them on the right a lone man in a boat. On the left bank the gable end of a house with light-coloured cladding and tall deciduous trees. In the distance a bridge and to the right of it a three-masted sailboat.

6531.d: Ees rannariba veeloikudega. Keskplaanil sile merepind paari valendava purjekaga.
6531.de: In front a strip of shore with puddles of water. In the middle ground a smooth sea surface with a couple of pale sailing boats.

6532.de: On the right a beach with a flock of sheep, on the left the sea.

6533.d: Lainetav merepind, esiplaanil vasakul neljamehega kaluripaat, paremal tagapool kaks eemalduvat paati. Kaugemal silmapiiril uduselt näha kaks kahe mastiga laeva. Taeval pilved.
6533.de: A wavy sea surface, in the foreground on the left a fishing boat with four men, on the right further back two boats moving away. In the distance on the horizon, hazily visible, two two-masted ships. Clouds in the sky.

6534.d: Meri kuuvalgel ööl. Esiplaanil keskel 2 paati sõudjatega, silmapiiril udu. Taevas kergelt pilves.
6534.de: Sea on a moonlit night. In the foreground in the middle 2 boats with rowers, mist on the horizon. The sky is slightly cloudy.

6535.d: lõuendi kaitseks papp alusraami külge löödud Asukoht objektil: tagaküljel
6535.de: cardboard nailed to the stretcher to protect the canvas. Location on object: on the verso

6537.d: Lainetav merepind, keskel suur traallaev, paremal uduses kauguses veel kaks traallaeva.
6537.de: Rippling sea surface, a large trawler in the middle, two more trawlers in the hazy distance on the right.

6543.d: Avar, panoraamne sügismaastik Lõuna-Eestist. Esiplaanil põllud, üksikud kased ja männid. Taga keskel järv, puude ja majade grupp. Taamal sinetavad mäenupud.
6543.de: A broad, panoramic autumn landscape from South Estonia. In the foreground fields, single birches and pines. Behind in the middle a lake, a group of trees and houses. In the distance bluish hilltops.

6546.d: Vaade Kloostrimetsast Piritale. Lumine, kohati paljas maastik raagus puude ja halli lookleva jõega. Taamal paistavad mõned punaste katustega majad ning Pirita kloostri varemed.
6546.de: View of Pirita from Kloostrimets. Snowy, in places bare landscape with bare trees and a grey winding river. In the distance a few houses with red roofs and the ruins of Pirita Convent can be seen.

6577.d: Esiplaanil kaks raagus puud, latt-tara, hoonete lumised katused. Härmanud.
6577.de: In the foreground two bare trees, a lath fence, snowy roofs of buildings. Frosted.

6578.d: Esiplaanil naine lapsega kõndimas piki puutaraga äärestatud tänavat. Tara taga viis raagus puud, lumine lagendik ja majade siluetid. Koloriit beežikas hall.
6578.de: In the foreground a woman with a child walking along a street lined with a wooden fence. Behind the fence five bare trees, a snowy open area and silhouettes of houses. Colouring beige-grey.

6579.d: Noore naise rindportree kerges pöördes paremale. Tumedad sirged õlgadele langevad juuksed. Punaseruuduline jakk, valge krae.
6579.de: Bust portrait of a young woman in a slight turn to the right. Dark straight hair falling to the shoulders. Red-checked jacket, white collar.

6580.d: Keskealise mehe rinnaportree otsevaates. Juuksed mustad, silmad mustjaspruunid, ilmekad. Ülikond külmas pruunis toonis, särk roosaka varjundiga, lips rohelise-valge triibuline. Fooniks terashall, voltides pruunikat tooni draperii.
6580.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man, frontal view. Black hair, dark brownish-black expressive eyes. Suit in cold brown tone, shirt with a pinkish shade, tie striped green and white. Background steel-grey, drapery in brownish tone in folds.

6712.d: Kahe kaevuri kolmveerandfiguurid.Parempoolne kaevur pöördes vasakule, teine peaga otse. Ta paremal õlal puur mootori ja juhtmega.
6712.de: Three-quarter figures of two miners. The right-hand miner turned to the left, the other with his head facing straight ahead. On his right shoulder a drill with a motor and cable.

6713.d: Vasakul ümmargune laud, mille ümber istuvad kaks meest ja nende vahel üks naine. Vasakpoolsel mehel käes suits.
6713.de: On the left a round table, around which two men are sitting with a woman between them. The man on the left has a cigarette in his hand.

6717.d: Vanema piibuga mehe rinnafiguur kerges pöördes vasakule. Seljas karusnahkse kraega mantel, kaelas kirju sall. Foon tume.
6717.de: Chest-length figure of an older man with a pipe, in slight turn to the left. Wearing a coat with a fur collar, a colourful scarf around the neck. Dark background.

6720.d: Lühikeste tumedate juustega keskealise mehe poolfiguur poolpöördes vasakule. Karusnahkse kraega mantli hõlmad lahti, paremas tõstetud käes klaas. Mehe pea pisut ette kallutatud, pilk vaatajal. Foon ja rõivastus heledais hallikais toonides, nägu, käsi punakais, ookertoonides kantud lühikeste pintslilöökidega.
6720.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man with short dark hair, turned half-way to the left. The flaps of his fur-collared coat are open, in his raised right hand a glass. The man's head is slightly bent forward, gaze on the viewer. The background and clothing are in light greyish tones, the face and hand in reddish, ochre tones applied with short brushstrokes.

6721.d: Vanema mehe rinnafiguur pooleldi tagantvaates, pea pööratud vaataja poole profiili. Mehel seljas kollakasrohelistes toonides ruuduline särk ja läikiva seljaga vest. Hallid vuntsid ja pealaelt hõrenenud juuksed, tugev nina ja lõug. Foon rohekates ja ookritoonides.
6721.de: The bust of an elderly man, half seen from behind, head turned towards the viewer in profile. The man wears a chequered shirt in yellowish-green tones and a vest with a shiny back. Grey moustache and thinning hair at the crown, strong nose and chin. Background in greenish and ochre tones.

6723.d: Hallikal taustal ja alusel seadeldis mustjaspruuni lähkri ja avatud kaanega külili puust õllekapaga paremal. Laiade pintslilöökidega hoogne maalilaad.
6723.de: On a greyish background and base, an arrangement with a blackish-brown flagon and, on the right, a wooden beer tankard lying on its side with an open lid. Vigorous painting style with broad brushstrokes.

6737.d: Rohekashallides toonides heinamaa ümmarguste saadude ja metsatukkadega. Ülal keskel kollakas täiskuu.
6737.de: Meadow in greyish-green tones with round haystacks and clumps of forest. At the top centre a yellowish full moon.

6738.d: Kirev sügisene maastik veekoguga pilvise taeva all. Ees keskel jõekäänaku vaheline rohune kallas. Tagapool, kõrgema päikesest valgustatud kalda peal üksikud kollased kased. Puude vahelt paistmas hoonete nurki. Realistlik kujutamislaad.
6738.de: A colourful autumn landscape with a body of water under a cloudy sky. In the front, in the middle, a grassy bank between a river bend. Behind, on a higher, sun-lit bank, solitary yellow birches. Between the trees, corners of buildings are visible. Realistic manner of depiction.

6752.d: Esiplaanil Kalini ümber koondunud neli mehe figuuri. Paremal tööpink. Tagapool vasakul veel üks seisev ja üks istuv mehe figuur.
6752.de: In the foreground four male figures gathered around Kalinin. On the right a workbench. Further back on the left another standing and one seated male figure.

6758.d: Suvine vaade piki äärelinna veelompidega kaetud tänavat. Kahel pool teed planktaraga piiratud roheliste puude-põõsastega aiad. Vihmavines taevas.
6758.de: Summer view along a suburban street covered with puddles of water. On both sides of the road, gardens with green trees and bushes enclosed by picket fences. Rainy sky.

6759.d: Esiplaanil heinamaadevaheline küngas kireva puudetuka ja teerajaga. Paremal sügisvärvides madal mets kahvatusinise taeva all. Elav, esiplaanil pastoosne pintslikiri.
6759.de: In the foreground a hill between hayfields with a colourful clump of trees and a path. On the right a low forest in autumn colours under a pale blue sky. Lively, in the foreground a pastose brushwork.

6760.d: Varakevadine lumega kaetud metsaalune. Paremal üksikuid sulanud laike madalate kuuskede, raagus ja kohati härmas puude all. Vasakul kaks kõrget tumedat kuuske kahvatu lillakashalli võsa taustal. Elav pintslikiri.
6760.de: Early spring, snow-covered forest floor. On the right isolated patches of melted snow under low spruces, among bare and, in places, frost-covered trees. On the left two tall dark spruces against a background of pale lilac-grey undergrowth. Lively brushwork.

6761.d: Võsa, põõsapuhmaste, teerajaga ääristatud looduslikud heinamaasiilud. Ees porise raja kõrval raagus põõsastel üksikud hallikad lehed. Silmapiiril, vihmavines halli taeva all metsa samblahall triip.
6761.de: Natural meadow strips bordered by scrub, bushy thickets and a path. In front, beside the muddy path, on bare bushes single greyish leaves. On the horizon, in the rain haze under a grey sky, a moss-grey strip of forest.

6770.d: Ülalt vaade linnamüüri kaitsetornidele. Eemalt paistab meri.
6770.de: View from above of the town wall's defence towers. The sea is visible in the distance.

6811.d: Panoraammaastik, esiplaanil kollased viljapõllud üksikute puude ja põõsastega. Paremal servas kõrgelt kaldapealselt nähtud meri, vasakul metsaga kaetud mäekünkad. Ülal sügavsinine, ähvardavate pilvedega kaetud taevas. Koloriit üles ehitatud kollase ja tumesinise kontrastile.
6811.de: Panoramic landscape, in the foreground yellow grain fields with individual trees and bushes. On the right edge, the sea seen from a high bank, on the left wooded hilly mountains. Above, a deep blue sky covered with threatening clouds. The colouring is built on the contrast of yellow and dark blue.

6829.d: Keskel jõgi, paremal taga uduvines linna panoraam suitsevate vabrikukorstnatega. Vasakul kaldale tõmmatud paadid ja vanad puud.
6829.de: A river in the middle, in the back on the right a hazy panorama of a city with smoking factory chimneys. On the left, boats pulled onto the shore and old trees.

6830.d: Esiplaanil paremal raagus puud. Kesklaanil jõgi, sillaga vasakul jõesadam. Jõgi kohati jääga kaetud.
6830.de: In the foreground on the right, bare trees. In the middle ground a river, with a bridge, on the left a river harbour. The river partly covered with ice.

6833.d: Ülaservas ja paremal suured allapoole langevad puuoksad, mis sulavad ühte tihedalt lilli ja põõsaid täis kasvanud aia rohelusega. Keskel roosakas teerada mille lõpus paistavad heledalt valgustatud põõsad.
6833.de: At the top edge and on the right, large drooping tree branches merge with the greenery of a garden densely overgrown with flowers and bushes. In the centre, a pinkish path at the end of which brightly lit bushes can be seen.

6834.d: Esiplaanil peaaegu frontaalselt lai aknalaud ja alaosa suurest aknast. Läbi ruudustiku paistab uduselt talvine linnavaade. Vasakul akna taga raagus puu. Ruumi sees akna ees vasakul valge viini tool. Aknalaual lill ja mitmesuguseid esemeid.
6834.de: In the foreground, an almost frontal view of a wide windowsill and the lower part of a large window. Through the grid a hazy winter cityscape is visible. On the left, behind the window, a bare tree. Inside the room, in front of the window on the left, a white Viennese chair. On the windowsill a flower and various objects.

6837.d: Esiplaanil allee. Vasakul ja paremal puud. Teel inimesi.
6837.de: In the foreground an alley. Trees on the left and right. People on the path.

6843.d: Lai jõgi lehtpuudega kallastel. Vasakul randumissild ja paadid, paremal hooneid ja kõrge suitsev korsten.
6843.de: A wide river with deciduous trees on the banks. On the left a landing pier and boats, on the right buildings and a tall smoking chimney.

6850.d: Esiplaanil lumine kivi- ja raudtaraga piiratud väljak. Väljakul liivakast, mille ümber pingid. Liivakastist vasakul kaks raagus puud. Kivi- ja raudtara taga maja- ja aedade foonil jalakäijad tänaval.
6850.de: In the foreground, a snowy square enclosed by a stone and iron fence. In the square a sandbox, surrounded by benches. To the left of the sandbox, two bare trees. Behind the stone and iron fence, pedestrians on the street against a background of houses and gardens.

6851.d: Esiplaanil haljasala pargitee, puude ja pinkidega. Paremal ja taga tänav majadega. Eemalt paistavad korstnad ja tornid.
6851.de: In the foreground a green area with a park path, trees and benches. On the right and in the background a street with houses. In the distance chimneys and towers are visible.

6861.d: Udune suvehommik hõredate mändide ja põõsatuttidega rabamaastikul. Esiplaanil rohune lagendik, tagapool metsaveer sinkjas udus.
6861.de: A hazy summer morning in a bog landscape with sparse pines and clumps of bushes. In the foreground a grassy clearing, further back the edge of a forest in bluish haze.

6869.d: Esiplaanil keskel teerada. Vasakul paremal ja taga suured põlispuud. Esiplaani puude varjust avaneb vaade päikesest valgustatud lagendikule.
6869.de: In the foreground in the middle a path. On the left, right and in the back large ancient trees. From the shadow of the foreground trees a view opens onto a sunlit clearing.

6870.d: Esiplaanil vasakult paremale suunduv tee madala kiviaiaga. Selle kõrval suur puu, mille lehestik võtab enda alla suure osa pildipinnast. Vasakul ja paremal väiksemaid puid. Vasakul puude all valge maja.
6870.de: In the foreground a road running from left to right with a low stone wall. Beside it a large tree, the foliage of which takes up a large part of the picture surface. Smaller trees on the left and right. On the left, under the trees, a white house.

6871.d: Tasane õhtune maastik. Esiplaanil kollakates-pruunikates toonides põld viljarõukudega. Põllu taga põõsaste vahel jõgi. Üle jõe vaade madalale soisele luhale üksikute suurte puudega. Horisondil keskel madal kõrgendik. Taevas rohekates-lillakates toonides.
6871.de: A flat evening landscape. In the foreground a field in yellowish-brownish tones with grain stacks. Behind the field, among bushes, a river. Across the river a view of a low marshy floodplain with a few large trees. On the horizon in the centre a low elevation. Sky in greenish-purplish tones.

6875.d: Järveäärsel põllul hulk rahvast viljakoristustöödel. Paremal rehepeksumasin, selle ümber askeldavad inimesed, keskel kaks naist põhukubu hangu otsas kandmas. Vasakul kaks meest ja naine põhukuja tegemas, tagapool hobune viljakoormaga. Tumeneva õhtutaeva all metsaga kaetud mäekuppel, peegeldus vees.
6875.de: In a field by a lake, a crowd of people at harvest work. On the right a threshing machine, around it people bustling about, in the centre two women carrying a sheaf of straw on a pitchfork handle. On the left two men and a woman making a straw stack, further back a horse with a load of grain. Under a darkening evening sky, a forest-covered hill, reflected in the water.

6888.d: Lumega kaetud Lõuna-Eesti maastik, põõsaste ja puudegruppe, esiplaanil tee jälgi, silmapiiril metsamüür. Taevas hall. Põllul lumest paljaid musti laike.
6888.de: A snow-covered South Estonian landscape, groups of bushes and trees, in the foreground tracks of a road, on the horizon a wall of forest. The sky grey. Black patches bare of snow in the field.

6911.d: Esiplaanil lennukimudel ja kuus töösse süvenenud, arutlevat noort konstruktorit laua ümber. Paremas nurgas näha toolileen. Väike poiss selgvaates pioneerirätikuga kaelas, kehaga vastu lauda toetumas. Üleval keskel mudellennuk rippumas. Seinal kahe raamitud pildi vahel plakat, mis kujutab lendurit noorte mudellendurite keskel.
6911.de: In the foreground a model airplane and six young engineers absorbed in discussion, gathered around a table. In the right corner a chair back can be seen. A small boy in full view with a pioneer scarf around his neck, leaning with his body against the table. Above in the centre a model airplane hanging. On the wall between two framed pictures a poster depicting a pilot among young model-aircraft builders.

6912.d: Ees keskel talutares õlgedel lamav noor mees, pea toetumas vasakule käele. Temast paremal rahvarõivais istuv naine. Taga kannelt helistav vanamees ja kaks last.
6912.de: In the front centre, in a farmhouse room, a young man lying on straw, his head resting on his left hand. To his right, a woman in folk costume sitting. In the background, an old man playing the kannel and two children.

6913.d: Esiplaanil viiulit mängiva, seisva mehe poolfiguur, profiilis vasakule. Tagaplaanil keskel kuulava mehe sidemes pea.
6913.de: In the foreground, half-figure of a standing man playing the violin, in profile to the left. In the background, centre, the bandaged head of a listening man.

6914.d: Pime ruum madala aknaga. Akna juures seisab väike tüdruk, vasakul rohelise kattega voodi. Paremal tool ja redel, reheahi.
6914.de: A dark room with a low window. By the window stands a little girl, on the left a bed with a green cover. On the right a chair and a ladder, a threshing-barn stove.

6915.d: Esiplaanil nattadega mineva mehe poolfiguur profiilis vasakule. Taga veepind ja kõrge horisondiga maastik.
6915.de: In the foreground the half-length figure of a man going with a knapsack, in profile to the left. Behind, a water surface and a landscape with a high horizon.

6916.d: Vana istuv naine profiilis vasakule. Vasaku käega kallutab kaussi, paremas lusikas. Paremal põrandal kass.
6916.de: An old woman sitting in profile to the left. With her left hand she tilts a bowl, in her right hand a spoon. On the floor on the right a cat.

6949.d: Mereväelase mundris keskealise mehe kolmveerandfiguur istuvas asendis. Parema käe pöial kitli hõlma vahel, vasak käsi tooli leenil. Peas valge põhjaga "mereväelase müts".
6949.de: A three-quarter figure of a middle-aged man in a naval uniform, in a seated position. The thumb of his right hand is tucked between the folds of his coat, his left hand rests on the arm of the chair. On his head a white-based "naval cap".

6988.d: Lumises, siniste varjudega metsalagendikul keskel grupp heledatüvelisi kuuski, kaugemal metsaviirg. Rohekas taevas roosakad pilved.
6988.de: In a snowy forest clearing with blue shadows, in the centre a group of light-trunked spruces, further away a strip of forest. Greenish sky with pinkish clouds.

7004.d: Vasakult paremale suunduvate diagonaaljoontega laual hele linik rohelise kõrvitsa, õuntega taldriku ja kõrvitsalõigu vahel. Linikul kolm sibulat. Laud pehmes pruunis toonis, kõrvitsad intentsiivse-kollase ja rohelisega, õunad punasega maalitud.
7004.de: On a table with diagonal lines running from left to right, a light cloth between a green pumpkin, a plate of apples and a piece of pumpkin. On the cloth three onions. The table in a soft brown tone, the pumpkins painted in intense yellow and green, the apples in red.

7005.d: Väga kirjudes värvides sügismaastik. Esiplaanil lage nõlvak, keskosas sügisvärvides puud ja põõsad. Taamal kõrgendik metsaga. Metsa ääres paremal väike heledates toonides maja. Taevas sinakates-punakates-lillakates toonides. Maalitud väikese pintsliga, lühikeste tihedate löökidega.
7005.de: A very colourful autumn landscape. In the foreground an open slope, in the middle part trees and bushes in autumn colours. Beyond, a hill with forest. At the edge of the forest on the right a small light-coloured house. The sky in bluish-reddish-purplish tones. Painted with a small brush, in short dense strokes.

7006.d: Sinistes toonides suvemaastik kasesaluga esiplaanil. Paremal kännu otsas istuv heledas riietuses naine, vasakul kasetüve vastu toetuv mees heledas särgis ja tumedas vestis.
7006.de: Summer landscape in blue tones with a birch grove in the foreground. On the right a woman in light clothing sitting on a stump, on the left a man in a light shirt and dark waistcoat leaning against a birch trunk.

7012.d: Esiplaanil liivane mererand nelja paadiga. Taamal meri.
7012.de: Sandy seashore with four boats in the foreground. The sea beyond.

7013.d: Esiplaanil liivane mererand, millele tõmmatud paat. Tagapool paremal vees kaks paati inimestega.
7013.de: In the foreground a sandy sea shore with a boat pulled up onto it. Further back on the right in the water two boats with people.

7014.d: Esiplaanil lage lumine väli, tagaplaanil puude vahel rida hooneid. Paremal inimfiguure.
7014.de: In the foreground an open snowy field, in the background a row of buildings among the trees. Human figures on the right.

7034.d: Kompositsioon inimfiguuridest, keskmega töö ülemises vasakus neljandikus. Esiplaanil vasakul seljaga vaataja poole pruunis rüüs naine. Koloriit hele. Maalitud suures osas pahtli või maalinoaga. Värvipind osaliselt faktuurne.
7034.de: A composition of human figures, with the centre of the work in the upper left quarter. In the foreground on the left a woman in a brown robe seen from behind facing the viewer. Light coloration. Painted largely with a palette knife or painting knife. The paint surface partly textured.

7109.d: Tumeda, sangadega vaasi foonil esiplaanil kitsas, kaela poole kergelt laienev, punane vaas. Selle kõrval vasakul üks ning paremal kaks madalat keraamilist nõud. Taust kollane, alus kirju.
7109.de: Against the background of a dark vase with handles, in the foreground a narrow red vase, slightly widening towards the neck. Beside it, on the left one and on the right two shallow ceramic vessels. Background yellow, the stand mottled.

7116.d: Tumesinises ülikonnas keskealine mees otsevaates valge linaga laua taga, vasak käsi toetub lauale. Laual taldrik, karahvin, kaks pitsi. Mehel ovaalne nägu, täidlased huuled, pisut tõstetud kulmud. Tumedad juuksed ülepea kammitud. Taustaks laiade pintslitõmmetega maalitud sein, vasakul ukseava, paremal pilt seinal.
7116.de: A middle-aged man in a dark blue suit, seen frontally, behind a table with a white cloth, his left hand resting on the table. On the table a plate, a carafe, two small glasses. The man has an oval face, full lips, slightly raised eyebrows. Dark hair combed straight back. The background is a wall painted with broad brushstrokes, a doorway on the left, a picture on the wall on the right.

7119.d: Keskosas, vasakult kahe tünni, paremalt palgivirna vahel kastil istub sonimütsis mees veerandpöördes vasakule, jalad harkis, käed toetuvad põlvedele. Tema selja taga punases seelikus naine selgvaates, pisut vasakule kummargil. Tagapool vasakul kolme istuva noormehe figuurid. Esiplaanil kail suur kala, ümberlükatud ämber, põrandahari. Tagaplaanil meri tumeda kaldatriibuga silmapiiril. Maal pastelseis roosakas-sinistes toonides.
7119.de: In the middle section, between two barrels on the left and a woodpile on the right, a man in a sailor's cap sits on a crate in a quarter turn to the left, legs apart, hands resting on his knees. Behind him a woman in a red skirt, in full view, bending slightly to the left. Further back at left, the figures of three seated young men. In the foreground on the pier a large fish, an overturned bucket, a floor brush. In the background the sea with a dark strip of shore on the horizon. The painting is in pastel pinkish-blue tones.

7121.d: Noore naise poolfiguur kerges pöördes vasakule. Tumedad lühikesed juuksed, punane barett, must ilma varrukateta sviiter.
7121.de: Half-figure of a young woman in slight turn to the left. Dark short hair, red beret, black sleeveless sweater.

7144.d: Õitsvate põõsaste ja puude keskel istub kirjus kleidis otsevaates naine, jalg üle põlve. Vasakul valge puudel, paremal lillekorv, reha ja kastekann. Tagapool vasakul molberti taga selgvaates kunstnik maalimas.
7144.de: Amid blossoming bushes and trees sits a woman in a patterned dress, frontal view, leg crossed over knee. On the left a white bench, on the right a flower basket, a rake and a watering can. Behind, on the left, an artist seen from the back, painting at an easel.
