7145.d: Punaste eesriiete taustal viis baleriini, üks neist otsevaates, kolm seljaga, üks istub, seljas rohekates, kollastes ja lillakates toonides kostüümid. Punased ja pruunikad toonid tihedad ja rasked.
7145.de: Against a background of red curtains, five ballerinas, one of them shown frontally, three with their backs turned, one seated, wearing costumes in greenish, yellow and lilac tones. The red and brownish tones are dense and heavy.

7158.d: Vaade linnulennult üle esiplaanis asuvate põldude, vasakul ja silmapiiril asuvate metsatukkade ja järve. Ülal lillakassinine taevas. Valitsevad sinised ja rohelised toonid.
7158.de: Bird's-eye view over fields in the foreground, groves of trees on the left and on the horizon, and a lake. Above, a purplish-blue sky. Blue and green tones dominate.

7161.d: Musta-valgetriibulisel linikul ja taustal lihtne klaasvaas roosade lillhernestega.
7161.de: On a black-and-white striped cloth and background a simple glass vase with pink sweet peas.

7162.d: Punasekirju salliga keskealise brüneti naise portree otsevaates.
7162.de: Frontal portrait of a middle-aged brunette woman with a red-patterned scarf.

7164.d: Pruun lillevaas kahe roosa ja ühe valge krüsanteemiga. Vaasi all ja vasakul foonil musta- ja valgetriibuline riie.
7164.de: Brown flower vase with two pink and one white chrysanthemum. Below the vase and to the left in the background a black-and-white striped fabric.

7250.d: Esiplaanil 6-nurksel laual valge emaileeritud kann, milles suur kimp valgeid lopsakaid pojenge. Kannu kõrval punase-halli triibulisel linikul klaasist vaasis punased lilled, vaasi ees puukauss lakkmaalinguga.
7250.de: In the foreground on a hexagonal table a white enamelled jug with a large bouquet of lush white peonies. Next to the jug, on a red-grey striped cloth, red flowers in a glass vase, in front of the vase a wooden bowl with lacquer painting.

7251.d: Kõrge horisondiga lage maastik. Diagonaalselt vasakule suunduv tee. Taga vasakul rühm hooneid.
7251.de: Bare landscape with a high horizon. A road leading diagonally to the left. Behind on the left a group of buildings.

7255.d: Vaade ühekorruselistele agulimajadele. Esiplaanil puutaraga ümbritsetud õunapuuaed, kaugemal pruunikad ja luitunud puumajad lumiste katustega. Pehmed värvitoonid nüanssidega, maalitud kergelt.
7255.de: View of single-storey suburban houses. In the foreground an apple orchard enclosed by a wooden fence, further away brownish and faded wooden houses with snowy roofs. Soft colour tones with nuances, painted lightly.

7257.d: Paremal kõrge kuusemets, selle taga ja vasakul roosa taevas. Esiplaanil lõkke ümber istuvad inimesed, vasakul seisab valges pluusis ja punases seelikus tütarlaps käed hõikamiseks suu juurde tõstetud.
7257.de: On the right, a tall spruce forest, behind it and on the left a pink sky. In the foreground, people sitting around a campfire, on the left a girl stands in a white blouse and red skirt with her hands raised to her mouth as if calling out.

7259.d: Otsevaates istuv mees. Peas hele kaabu, seljas tume mantel, mille hõlmad eest lahti. Kaelas valge krae punase ristlipsuga. Parem käsi toetub parema jalale, vasak puusas. Kuue servadel Stalini preemia medal. Temast paremal paistab osaliselt töödel lebav portfell.
7259.de: A man sitting in a frontal view. On his head a light-coloured hat, wearing a dark coat with the flaps open in front. Around his neck a white collar with a red cross-tie. His right hand rests on his right leg, the left on his hip. On the edges of his coat the Stalin Prize medal. To his right a briefcase lying on papers is partly visible.

7262.d: Noore naise poolfiguur seisvas asendis, keha pöördes vasakule. Käes kast kaladega. Peas roosa rätik, seljas lilleline pluus, käes presentkindad.
7262.de: The half-figure of a young woman in a standing position, body turned to the left. In her hands a box with fish. On her head a pink kerchief, wearing a floral blouse, on her hands tarpaulin gloves.

7263.d: Vanema mehe rinnakujtuis vasakule. Hallid juuksed, prillid, tume ülikond.
7263.de: Bust portrait of an older man, turned to the left. Grey hair, glasses, dark suit.

7264.d: Hallipäise mehe portree poolprofiilis paremale. Valge krae, punasekirju lips, must kuub, rohekas foon.
7264.de: Portrait of a grey-haired man in half-profile to the right. White collar, red-patterned tie, black jacket, greenish background.

7266.d: Lainetest üleuhutud lauter suunaga diametraalselt paremast nurgast vasakule poole. Telefoniliin, mootorpaat.
7266.de: A boat washed up by waves, oriented diametrically from the right corner towards the left. A telephone line, a motorboat.

7268.d: Nelja seisva mehe poolfiguurid mererannas. Keskmine mees topib piipu, parempoolsel köiepundar õlal.
7268.de: Half-figures of four standing men on a seashore. The middle man is filling a pipe, the one on the right has a coil of rope on his shoulder.

7269.d: Vanema istuva naise kolmveerand figuur otsevaates. Käed süles koorib kartulit. Valge rätt, sinine pluus, punakas põll. Tume pruunikas foon, paremal lauanurk.
7269.de: Three-quarter figure of an elderly seated woman, frontal view. Hands in her lap, peeling a potato. White kerchief, blue blouse, reddish apron. Dark brownish background, a table corner at right.

7286.d: Esiplaanil maapind üksikute lumelaikudega. Keskel tee. Vasakul taluhoone ja raagus puud. Eemal künkad, mis kaovad sinisesse uduvinesse.
7286.de: In the foreground the ground with isolated patches of snow. In the middle a road. On the left a farm building and bare trees. In the distance hills that disappear into a bluish haze.

7287.d: Esiplaanil vesi. Selle taga tumedad künkad metsaga. Kollakalt hõõguv taevas.
7287.de: In the foreground, water. Behind it, dark hills with forest. A yellowishly glowing sky.

7352.d: Esiplaanil, paralleelselt pildipinnal kitsas tee ja madalad kiviaiad, mille taga pikad madalad hooned. Paremal majade vahel üksikud puud. Madal horisont, lage taevas valgete pilvedega.
7352.de: In the foreground, running parallel to the picture plane, a narrow road and low stone walls, behind which long low buildings. On the right, solitary trees among the houses. Low horizon, open sky with white clouds.

7362.d: Lillakal foonil istub noor naine kehapöördega vasakule, pilk suunatud vaatajale. Nägu korrapäraste näojoontega, siledad juuksed taha kammitud. Küünarnukkideni paljastatud käed tugevad, parem käsi ovaalsel toolikorjul, vasakus avatus raamat. Kleit sinise-punase-halli kirju, maalitud täppivalt krobelise faktuuriga.
7362.de: Against a purple background a young woman is seated with her body turned to the left, her gaze directed at the viewer. Face with regular features, smooth hair combed back. Arms bare to the elbows are strong, the right hand on the oval armrest of the chair, an open book in the left. Dress in blue-red-grey pattern, painted with a dotted, rough texture.

7393.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kollendavate ranna-äärsete saartega veelahe, keskel laiub tumedapinnaline järv ranna- ja metsavarjudega veepinnal. Järvekaldalt keskel metsaga kaetud mägi. Taevas pilves. Maalitud soojade hallide pruunide toonidega, laia pintslitõmbega.
7393.de: In the foreground on the left a watershed with yellowish coastal islands, in the centre a dark-surfaced lake spreads with shadows of shore and forest on the water's surface. From the lakeshore in the centre a forest-covered mountain. Sky cloudy. Painted in warm grey-brown tones, with a broad brushstroke.

7395.d: Esiplaanil valged künkad madalate pruunikate põõsastega. Kõrge horisont, taeval valged pilved.
7395.de: In the foreground white hills with low brownish bushes. High horizon, white clouds in the sky.

7396.d: Esiplaanil kai laevadega, selle ääres domineeriv punakas toon, eriti punane on veoauto. Laht rohekalt sillerdav. Tagapool maju, laevu, kaarsildu.
7396.de: In the foreground a quay with ships, along it a dominant reddish tone, especially red is the delivery truck. The bay shimmering greenish. In the background houses, ships, arch bridges.

7398.d: Esiplaanil veekogu, keskplaanilt kõrge silmapiirini laiub metsaga kaetud nõlvak. Maalitud pastoosselt, rohekaspruunikates ja roosakates üksteisesse sulatatud toonides, milles helendavad puutüved.
7398.de: In the foreground a body of water, from the middle ground up to the high horizon a forest-covered slope extends. Painted pastosely, in greenish-brown and pinkish tones blended into one another, in which the tree trunks glow.

7489.d: Paremal vesi, vasakul paadisild. Tagapool hooned ja puud.
7489.de: On the right water, on the left a boat pier. Behind, buildings and trees.

7490.d: Diagonaalselt paremalt vasakule kulgev tänav. Keskel heledasti valgustatud akendega maja, millest nelinurkne valguslaik langeb tänavale. Tänava kahelpool ääres mustad raagus puud. Esiplaanil vasakul inimsiluetid.
7490.de: A street running diagonally from right to left. In the centre a house with brightly lit windows, from which a rectangular patch of light falls onto the street. Black bare trees line both sides of the street. In the foreground on the left, human silhouettes.

7502.d: Noore naise pea profiilis, vaatega paremale. Peas kirju lilleline rätik. Taamal mets.
7502.de: Head of a young woman in profile, looking to the right. On her head a colourful floral scarf. In the distance, forest.

7522.d: Keskel Pirita kloostri varemed, millest vasakul  ja paremal mõned hooned. Lumine maastik.
7522.de: In the middle the ruins of Pirita Convent, to the left and right of which some buildings. A snowy landscape.

7535.d: Tumedas, rohelises üldkoloriidis maalitud veekogu kõrge liivakalda ning sellel kasvava tiheda metsaga. All paremas nurgas tuules rasitud kõrkjapuhmas.
7535.de: A body of water painted in a dark, green overall colour scheme, with a high sandy bank on which a dense forest grows. In the lower right corner a clump of sedge battered by the wind.

7607.d: Ees keskel kolm kaske, ladvad pildi ülaservaga äralõigatud. Lagedal lumisel maastikul üksikud noored kuused. Taamal metsasalu. Värvipind kergelt faktuurne. Maalimisel kasutatud pahtlit.
7607.de: In front in the center three birches, their tops cut off by the upper edge of the picture. In an open snowy landscape solitary young spruces. Beyond, a small grove. The paint surface is slightly textured. Putty was used in painting.

7608.d: Pehmetes pruunides toonides maalitud varakevadine maastik, suurte valkjate lumelaikudega. Kontuurid hajuvad. Maalipind kergelt faktuurne.
7608.de: Early spring landscape painted in soft brown tones, with large whitish patches of snow. Contours diffuse. The paint surface slightly textured.

7609.d: Lumine maastik roosaka kasesaluga, siniste varjudega. Esiplaanil keskel lagendik, üksik väike kuusk keskel, tagapool madal punase viilkatusega maja. Maalitud heledates, roosades-sinistes toonides lühikese pintslilöögiga.
7609.de: A snowy landscape with a pinkish birch grove, with blue shadows. In the foreground centre a clearing, a single small spruce in the middle, further back a low house with a red gable roof. Painted in light, pinkish-blue tones with short brushstrokes.

7610.dm: kõrgus: 38.0 cm (km); laius: 55.2 cm (lm); kõrgus: 53.5 cm (lm); laius: 46.5 cm (km)
7610.d: Roosakas-rohelistes toonides täppivas laadis maalitud ülaltvaade avarale kuplilisele maastikule, keskel looklev tee. Üksikud majad küngaste vahel. Paremal, silmapiiril aimatav kirikutorn.
7610.de: Painted in pinkish-green tones in a dotted manner, a bird's-eye view of an expansive domed landscape, with a winding road in the centre. Individual houses among the hills. On the right, on the horizon, a church tower can be discerned.

7611.d: Keskosas talvine väikelinna puiestee, kahel pool oranžide, hallide viilkatustega majad. Esiplaanil vasakul astuv inimene, paremal kaks figuuri selgvaates. Maalitud lühikese pintslilöögiga heledates sinakates toonides.
7611.de: In the middle section a wintery small-town boulevard, on both sides houses with orange, grey gable roofs. In the foreground on the left a walking figure, on the right two figures seen frontally. Painted with short brushstrokes in light bluish tones.

7612.d: Erksinisel foonil väänlevate okstega kolm männipuu tüve. Nende ees roheluses lopsakate erepunaste õitega moonid. Maalitud hoogsalt, pikemate pintslitõmmetega.
7612.de: Against a bright blue background, three pine trunks with twisting branches. In front of them, amid lush greenery, poppies with vivid red blooms. Painted vigorously, with longer brushstrokes.

7613.d: Peaaegu kogu pildi pinna võtavad enda alla kaks kergelt S-kujulise tüvega siugjalt väänlevate jämedate okstega puud. Ladva osad ning oksad pildi servadega äralõigatud. Tüved rohelised. Taustaks sinine taevas.
7613.de: Almost the entire surface of the picture is taken up by two thick-branched, slightly S-shaped trunked trees winding snake-like. The tops and branches are cut off by the edges of the picture. The trunks are green. The background is a blue sky.

7614.d: Rünkpilvise taeva all pastelsetes rohekais-roosades toonides põllud, kasesalud. Esiplaani keskel lillakasroosa looklev veekogu. Kaskede osas maal väga pastoosne.
7614.de: Under a sky with cumulus clouds, fields and birch groves in pastel greenish-pink tones. In the centre foreground, a lilac-pink winding body of water. The birches are painted very pastosely.

7615.d: Tumedal taustal ovaalne naisenägu veerandpöördes paremale, pilk suunatud alla heledatele õitele. Maalitud siledalt, tumepruunides toonides.
7615.de: On a dark background, an oval female face turned a quarter to the right, gaze directed down towards light-coloured flowers. Painted smoothly, in dark brown tones.

7616.d: Valgete rünkpilvedega taevatriibu all kollakas-pruunikas põld, esiplaanil hakid. Taamal vasakul, metsatuka ees kolm maja.
7616.de: Under a sky-band of white cumulus clouds, a yellowish-brown field, jackdaws in the foreground. In the distance on the left, three houses in front of a small wood.

7617.d: Pea-aegu pildi ülaservani tihedalt üksteise kõrval lumiste viilkatustega, kahkjates kollastes, roosades toonides majad. Esiplaanil veelomp ja kaks raagus puud. Koloriit hele; maalipind faktuurne.
7617.de: Almost up to the upper edge of the picture, houses with snowy gable roofs, in pale yellowish and pink tones, closely set side by side. In the foreground a puddle of water and two bare trees. Colouring light; painted surface textured.

7664.d: Realistlikult maalitud otsevaates seisva mehe täisfiguur. Pea kergelt pöördes vasakule, pilk suunatud alla. Mehel on peas hall sonimüts, seljas hall kuub, mille lahtiste hõlmade alt paistab erkpunane särk. Vasak käsi toetub värvlile, parem on sirgelt kõrval. Jalas on mehel hallid püksid ning hallides toonides kingad. Paremal pool seisab suurem pruunika karvaga koer 3/4 pöördes vasakule. Maali foon hallides toonides.
7664.de: Full figure of a man standing, viewed frontally, painted realistically. His head is turned slightly to the left, his gaze directed downward. The man wears a grey slouch hat, a grey coat, from under the open lapels of which a bright red shirt is visible. His left hand rests on a walking stick, his right hand hangs straight at his side. The man wears grey trousers and shoes in grey tones. On the right stands a larger dog with brownish fur, in a 3/4 turn to the left. The background of the painting is in grey tones.

7675.d: Madala laua ümber neli istuvat naist kanu kitkumas. Vasakpoolne naine seljaga, nägu profiilis, sinises põlles ja pearätis, teisel pool lauda kolm naist, keskmisel prillid, aknapoolsel heleroheline pluus.
7675.de: Around a low table, four women sitting plucking hens. The woman on the left with her back turned, face in profile, in a blue apron and headscarf; on the other side of the table three women, the middle one with glasses, the one by the window in a light green blouse.

7679.d: Talvise väikelinna vaatega aknal kaks lillepotti valgeõieliste amarüllistega, nende vahel väike pott kaktusega. Maalitud heledas, valkjassinises, pruunikas koloriidis.
7679.de: Winter view of a small town through a window with two flowerpots of white-blossomed amaryllis, between them a small pot with a cactus. Painted in a light, whitish-blue, brownish colouring.

7680.d: Esiplaanil vesi, tagapool kiravalt maalitud kõrgem kaldapealne suurte puude grupiga vasakul, mis peegeldub vette. Maalitud lühikese pintslilöögiga.
7680.de: In the foreground water, behind it a colourfully painted higher riverbank with a group of large trees on the left, reflected in the water. Painted with short brushstrokes.

7681.d: Lagedal lumisel maastikul tumeda taeva foonil kaks kaskede gruppi. Puude ladvaosad pildi ülaservaga äralõigatud. Värvigamma sinistes toonides.
7681.de: In an open snowy landscape against a dark sky background, two groups of birches. The tops of the trees are cut off by the upper edge of the picture. Colour scheme in blue tones.

7683.d: Eresinisel foonil suur pruun vaas pruunikate lehtedega. Selle ümber kolm lillepotti punaste alpikannidega. Maalitud hoogsalt, laiemate pintslilöökidega.
7683.de: Against a bright blue background a large brown vase with brownish leaves. Around it three flowerpots with red columbines. Painted vigorously, with broader brushstrokes.

7684.d: Liivasel rannal, vasakul kolm kõrget mändi. Puude vahelt paistab rohekas-halli taeva all madalas laines meri.
7684.de: On a sandy beach, on the left three tall pines. Between the trees, under a greenish-grey sky, the sea is visible in low waves.

7685.d: Rünkpilvise taeva all erksinine meri valgete purjekatega. Esiplaanil, vee piiril inimestegrupid, vasakul kõrged männid, päremal rohekad põõsatutid. Maalitud sinakaisrohelistes, beežides toonides.

7686.d: Vasakul, kirevaleheliste puude vahelt paistab erksinine veepind ning looklev rannajoon. Maalitud tihedate, täppivate pintslilöökidega. Puutüvede kontuur kergelt rõhutatud.
7686.de: At left, between colourful-leaved trees a bright blue water surface and a winding shoreline are visible. Painted with dense, dabbing brushstrokes. The contour of the tree trunks is slightly emphasized.

7688.d: Täppivate pintslilöökidega rohekas-hallikas koloriidis maalitud lage, veidi lainjas maastik. Esiplaanil kuus kadakat. Ülaservas kitsas helehall, kitsas taevaviirg.
7688.de: A bare, slightly undulating landscape painted in a greenish-grey palette with precise brushstrokes. Six junipers in the foreground. A narrow pale grey strip of sky along the upper edge.

7696.d: Vaade hoovi. Keskel punase katusega majad. Vasakul ja paremal heledad seinad, neist vasakpoolse küljes latern.
7696.de: View of a courtyard. In the middle houses with red roofs. On the left and right pale walls, with a lantern on the left-hand one.

7725.d: Sinistes ja lillakaspunastes toonides ülaltvaade Tallinna vanalinnale Niguliste kiriku kiivrita torniga paremal. Ülal tume pilvine taevas.
7725.de: A bird's-eye view of Tallinn's Old Town in blue and purplish-red tones, with the spireless tower of St. Nicholas' Church (Niguliste) on the right. Above, a dark cloudy sky.

7753.d: Noorema mehe poolfiguur kerge pöördega vasemale. Hoiab käes hammasratast.
7753.de: Half-figure of a younger man, slightly turned to the left. Holding a gear wheel in his hand.

7755.d: Lõuendi parempoolses osas valge kitli ja mütsikesega noore naise istuv poolfiguur. Vasakul hele ümmargune arstimite lauake pudelite ja riistadega. Üldkoloriit hele.
7755.de: In the right-hand part of the canvas, a seated half-figure of a young woman in a white smock and cap. On the left a light round medicine table with bottles and instruments. The overall colouring light.

7756.d: Perspektiivselt pildi sügavusse suunduv avar tehase interjöör üldvaates. Paremal põlev ahi, vasakul mitmesugused seadmed, millede juures mitmed töölisfiguurid.
7756.de: Perspectival view of a spacious factory interior receding into the depth of the picture, in a general view. On the right a burning furnace, on the left various installations, with several worker figures near them.

7758.d: Istuva vanema mehe poolfiguur profiilis vasakule. Paljas lagipea, prillid, tume ülikond, helesinine särk musta lipsuga. Vasak käsi toetatud laual. Taga vasakul raamaturiiul. Foon tumedates toonides.
7758.de: Half-figure of a seated older man in profile to the left. Bald crown, glasses, dark suit, light blue shirt with black tie. Left hand resting on the table. Behind on the left a bookshelf. Background in dark tones.

7785.d: Hallipäise, halli habeme ja prillidega mehe rinnaportree akna foonil. Mehe keha profiilis ja nägu veerandpöördes paremale.
7785.de: Bust portrait of a grey-haired man with a grey beard and glasses against the background of a window. The man's body in profile and face in a quarter-turn to the right.

7863.d: Sonimütsis ja rohekas vattkuues mees küünarnnukkidega toetumas mootorpaadi kajuti katusele. Taustal vasakul meri ja hele taevas.
7863.de: A man in a sou'wester hat and greenish quilted coat leaning with his elbows on the roof of a motorboat cabin. In the background on the left the sea and a bright sky.

7880.d: Esiplaanil pruunides toonides künkanõlv, vasakul tihe tumeroheline männitukk, paremal paar põõsast. Taevas ühtlaselt hallides ja roosakas-lillades toonides.
7880.de: In the foreground a slope of a hillock in brown tones, on the left a dense dark green pine thicket, on the right a couple of bushes. Sky evenly in grey and pinkish-lilac tones.

7888.d: Teise korruse aknast vaade talvisele tänavale. Paremal esiplaanil ja vasakul kaugemal maja nurk. Nende vahel tänav, kus liigub arvukalt inimesi mitmes suunas. Taamal lumine mäenõlv, millel üksikud pingid.
7888.de: View of a wintery street from a second-floor window. The corner of a house in the right foreground and further away on the left. Between them a street where numerous people are moving in several directions. In the distance a snowy hillside with a few benches.

7934.d: Süngeilmelise mehe poolfiguur tumedal foonil. Seljas avatud hõlmadega kasukas, peas talimüts. Figuur kerges pöördes paremale.
7934.de: Half-figure of a grim-looking man against a dark background. Wearing a fur coat with open flaps, on his head a winter hat. The figure in a slight turn to the right.

7935.d: Malelaua taga paremal mõtliku ilmega poiss, kelle parem käsi malenupul, vasak toetub lõuale; patsidega tütarlaps tema vastas kuklaga vaataja poole, figuuri poolitab maali vasakserv. Foon tume.
7935.de: At a chess table on the right a boy with a thoughtful expression, his right hand on a chess piece, left hand resting on his chin; a girl with braids sits opposite him with the back of her head toward the viewer, the figure is bisected by the left edge of the painting. Dark background.

7941.d: Esiplaanilt keskelt kääruline kivimüüridega ääristatud tee suundumas kõrgendikule. Keskplaanil kolm lameda katusega maja rõdudega. Vasakul müüri ääres kuristik. Foonil tumedalt kõrged mäed. Küpresse. Üldkoloriit hele-roosakas-lilla, maalitud spaatliga.
7941.de: In the foreground, from the middle, a winding road bordered by stone walls leading up to a height. In the middle ground, three flat-roofed houses with balconies. On the left, along the wall, a ravine. In the background, dark high mountains. Cypresses. Overall colouring light pinkish-purple, painted with a palette knife.

7942.d: Esiplaanil veepind, eemal keskel kaks paati. Vasakul paistab kaldariba majadega.
7942.de: In the foreground a water surface, with two boats in the distance at the centre. On the left a strip of shore with houses is visible.

7943.d: Esiplaanil pesukauss, mille sees külili kastekann. Sellest paremal sinine ämber. Vasakul teine suurem kastekann. Fooniks lilled.
7943.de: In the foreground a washbasin, inside which a watering can lying on its side. To its right a blue bucket. On the left another, larger watering can. Flowers as background.

8024.d: Esiplaanil kivine rand, mille keskel üks suur kivi. Paremal veepind üksikute kividega, vasemal taamal mets ja järsu kaldaga neem.
8024.de: In the foreground a stony shore with one large stone in the middle. On the right a water surface with isolated stones, on the left in the distance a forest and a headland with a steep bank.

8025.d: Esiplaanil õitsva taimestikuga aas. Keskplaanil vasakul mõned puud ja põõsad. Taustal paremal mõned elektri kõrgepinge postid.
8025.de: In the foreground a meadow with flowering vegetation. In the middle ground on the left a few trees and bushes. In the background on the right a few electric high-voltage poles.

8026.d: Vaikne merepind. Esiplaanil vasakul kaks kivi merel, paremal kolm kajakat lendamas. Horisondil vasakul hulk laevu ja paate.
8026.de: A calm sea surface. In the foreground on the left two rocks in the sea, on the right three seagulls flying. On the horizon on the left a number of ships and boats.

8028.d: Esiplaanil kõrge rohuga väike lagendik. Taga vasakul ja paremal kõrgemad puud, keskosas põõsad. Vasakul rohus teerada kahe väikese figuuriga. Mees mustas. Naine roosas riietuses.
8028.de: In the foreground a small clearing with tall grass. Behind, on the left and right, taller trees, in the middle section bushes. On the left in the grass a path with two small figures. A man in black. A woman dressed in pink.

8029.d: Esiplaanil põlvili mees. Teine habemes mees kaikaga hoogu võtmas. Tagapool edasi tormavad inimesed.
8029.de: A kneeling man in the foreground. Another bearded man gathering momentum with a club. Behind, people rushing forward.

8032.d: Esiplaanil tee, vasemal väike küngas suurte kividega ja üksikute põõsastega, paremal kaks tuulikut ja mõned hooned.
8032.de: A road in the foreground, on the left a small hillock with large stones and a few bushes, on the right two windmills and some buildings.

8071.d: Heledajuukselise tütarlapse - komnoore 3/4 figuur, otsevaates kriidiga paremas, raamatuga vasakus käes. Figuuri taga oleval seinatahvlil trigonomeetrilisi arvutusi.
8071.de: 3/4 figure of a fair-haired girl - a Young Pioneer, frontal view, with chalk in the right hand and a book in the left. On the wall panel behind the figure trigonometric calculations.

8100.d: Kompositsioon kitsast keerdtrepist nelja figuuriga. Allosas fragment noorest naisest profiilis, keskel punases kleidis naine, pilk ülesse suunatud. Trepil üleval kahe noormehe kuju. Summutatud toonid, selgepiiriline kujutamisviis. Taotluslikud krakleepinnas maalis.
8100.de: Composition of a narrow spiral staircase with four figures. Below a fragment of a young woman in profile, in the centre a woman in a red dress, gaze directed upward. On the staircase above the figures of two young men. Muted tones, clear-outlined manner of depiction. Deliberately crackled paint surface.

8101.d: Kolmefiguuriline kompositsioon mäest alla kihutavatest suusatajatest. Ees fragmentaarselt    kujutatud naine punases, juuksed tuules turris, suu pärani. Tema taga tuttmütsiga poolfiguur. Taga paremal poolkummargil nokkmütsi ja prillidega mees, suusakepp hoogsalt ette sirutatud. Värvikad figuurid heledal taustal.
8101.de: Three-figure composition of skiers racing down a mountain. In front a fragmentarily depicted woman in red, hair tousled in the wind, mouth wide open. Behind her a half-figure with a tufted cap. Behind on the right a half-bent man with a peaked cap and glasses, ski pole vigorously stretched forward. Colourful figures against a light background.

8102.d: Sünge maastikumotiiv sinisetüveliste puudega ääristatud kollase teega, erepunane käsipuu teepervel. Tagapool hoone nurk, silmapiiril helendab roosakas taevas. Ekspressiivne kujutamisviis, lai pintslikiri, tumedad kontuurid.
8102.de: A gloomy landscape motif with a yellow road bordered by blue-trunked trees, a bright red handrail at the roadside. Behind, the corner of a building, on the horizon a pinkish sky glowing. Expressive manner of depiction, broad brushwork, dark contours.

8103.d: Keskmes kaks teineteise vastu hoidvat figuuri istumas, vasakul kaabuga vana mees. Paremal punaka pearätiga vana naine, käed süles. Tumedad sinkjaslillad, punakad toonid. Ekspressiivne laad, tugevad värvikontrastid.
8103.de: In the centre two figures sitting holding onto each other, on the left an old man with a hat. On the right an old woman with a reddish headscarf, hands in her lap. Dark bluish-purple, reddish tones. Expressive manner, strong colour contrasts.

8105.d: Tuulisel rannal kolm naist: vasakul helesinises kleidis seisva nooriku poolfiguur, juuksed tuules, pilk ette alla suunatud; keskel otsevaates punases kleidis naine istumas, käed süles, pilk maas; paremal poolselgvaates naine valge pearätiga. Taustal valkjasroosa maapind tumeda
8105.de: On a windy beach, three women: on the left, the half-figure of a young woman standing in a light blue dress, hair in the wind, gaze directed downward and forward; in the middle, a woman in a red dress sitting in a frontal view, hands in her lap, gaze lowered; on the right, a woman in half-profile with a white headscarf. In the background, a whitish-pink ground with dark

8106.d: Madala toa sügavuses akna all voodis lamav haige, triibuline tekk üle. Ees paremal pearätis naine külgvaates, raamat käes. Voodi peatsis punakas riides naine istumas, rätt peas. Kontrastne värvikasutus, tumedate kontuuride vahel eredamad hõõguvad toonid. Ekspressiivne kujutamisviis.
8106.de: In the depths of a low room, under the window, a sick person lying in bed, covered with a striped blanket. In front on the right a woman in a headscarf in profile, holding a book. At the head of the bed a woman in reddish clothing sitting, a kerchief on her head. Contrasting use of colour, brighter glowing tones between dark contours. Expressive manner of depiction.

8109.d: Oranžikas vestis noore naise ülakeha roosakatel patjadel, vasak käsi heidetud üle pea, parem küljel. Pilukil silmade pilk suunatud kõrvale. Ekspressiivne laad. Näos rohekad toonid, mustjashall taust.
8109.de: The upper body of a young woman in an orange vest on pinkish pillows, left arm thrown over the head, right arm at the side. The gaze of the narrowed eyes is directed sideways. Expressive style. Greenish tones in the face, blackish-grey background.

8111.d: Tumepunases rõivas noore naise poolfiguur kerges pöördes paremale, parem käsi üle rinna. Naisel hele nägu, tõsine pilk, pikad pruunid juuksed seljal. Figuuri taustal interjöör piltidega
8111.de: Half-figure of a young woman in dark red clothing, in a slight turn to the right, right hand across the chest. The woman has a light face, a serious gaze, long brown hair on her back. In the background of the figure an interior with pictures

8157.d: Ees tõusev kõrgendik liivaste teeradade ja rohelusega. Vasemal puid ja hooneid puude vahel. Rinnakul kolm inimfiguuri.
8157.de: In front, a rising elevation with sandy paths and greenery. On the left trees and buildings among the trees. On the foreshore three human figures.

8158.d: Esiplaanil kollendav viljapõld kokkupandud viljarõukudega. Põllu ääres kiviaed, selle taga kasesalu. Hilissuvine taevas kergelt pilves.
8158.de: In the foreground a yellowing grain field with gathered sheaves of grain. At the edge of the field a stone wall, behind it a birch grove. Late-summer sky slightly cloudy.

8162.d: Ülaltvaade kitsale tänavale. Ees paremal majakatus ja osa seina kahe aknaga. Vasakul müür, mille taga paistavad puud ja majad. Taga kuni silmapiirini kaugenevad hooned ja katused.
8162.de: A top view of a narrow street. In front on the right a roof and part of a wall with two windows. On the left a wall, behind which trees and houses are visible. Behind, buildings and roofs receding into the distance to the horizon.

8165.d: Vaade Pirita jõele Jahtklubi juurest. Esiplaanil jõgi purjekatega, keskel hooneid ja puid.
8165.de: View of the Pirita River from the Yacht Club. In the foreground the river with sailboats, in the middle buildings and trees.

8167.d: Esiplaanil kivine, üksikute väikeste kadakapõõsastega maapind, tagapool nõlvakul tornikiivrita punase katusega kirik, mida piiravad puud-põõsad, vasakult paistab vana talumaja katus. Sinises taevas, mis võtab enese alla 2/3 maali pinnast, kergeid heledaid pilvesagaraid. Koloriidilt hele. Kullatud raam.
8167.de: In the foreground, stony ground with a few small juniper bushes, behind on a slope a church with a red roof and no tower spire, surrounded by trees and bushes, on the left the roof of an old farmhouse is visible. In the blue sky, which takes up 2/3 of the painting's surface, light bright cloud wisps. Light in colour scheme. Gilded frame.

8177.d: Keskealise mehe pea otsevaates. Peas lai must barett. Sinine avatud kaelusega särk ja lambanahast vest.
8177.de: Head of a middle-aged man in a direct view. On his head a wide black beret. A blue open-collared shirt and a sheepskin waistcoat.

8179.d: Laua ümber istub viis inimest. Nendest laua paremas otsas istuv mees kõnelemas, vasakus poisike põlvedega taburetil. Seinal Stalinit kujutav plakat.
8179.de: Five people sit around a table. Of these, the man sitting at the right end of the table is speaking, and on the left a boy sits on a stool with his knees drawn up. On the wall a poster depicting Stalin.

8180.d: Seltsimees Kalinin, prillidega, nooremas eas, "ИСКРА" vasakus käes, tööstusruumis tööpingi taga, ümbritsetud teda kuulavatest kaastöötajatest, kellest kolm istuvad esiplaanil. Nendest paremal pildi serval üksik seisev tööline. Taamal tööstusruumis kaksa vastassuunas liikuvat töölist,  kellest üks paljaihuga selgvaates, teine särgiväel üle õla köitpidi midagi tirimas. Esiplaanis vasakul tööpingi ees tööriistadega laud. Vasakpoolses seinas inimgruppide tagant paistab aken.
8180.de: Comrade Kalinin, wearing glasses, at a younger age, with "ИСКРА" in his left hand, in an industrial room behind a workbench, surrounded by co-workers listening to him, three of whom are sitting in the foreground. To the right of them, at the edge of the picture, a lone standing worker. Further back in the industrial room, two workers moving in opposite directions, one of them bare-bodied seen clearly, the other in his shirt pulling something with a rope over his shoulder. In the foreground on the left, a table with tools in front of the workbench. In the left wall, behind the groups of people, a window can be seen.

8181.d: Mehe kolmveerand figuur seisvas asendis, kerges pöördes paremale. Valges kitlis, käed seljataga. All paremal näha kirjutuslaua nurk.
8181.de: Three-quarter figure of a man in a standing position, in a slight turn to the right. In a white coat, hands behind his back. In the lower right the corner of a writing desk can be seen.

8182.d: Mereväelase poolfiguur, seisvas asendis poolpöördes vasakule. Seljas munder, ilma mütsita. Kokkupandud käed süles. Taga vasakul laeva mudel. Tume foon.
8182.de: Half-figure of a naval officer, standing in a half-turned position to the left. Wearing a uniform, without a cap. Hands folded in his lap. Behind on the left a model ship. Dark background.

8188.d: Keskealise naise täisfiguur istumas terastorust painutatud toolil 3/4 pöördes paremale. Nägu otsevaates. Tooli ees molbert. Naise seljas must pihikkleit ja beež pluus. Joonistusvahend paremas käes.
8188.de: Full figure of a middle-aged woman sitting on a bent steel-tube chair, turned 3/4 to the right. Face shown frontally. An easel in front of the chair. The woman is wearing a black pinafore dress and a beige blouse. A drawing implement in her right hand.

8189.d: Paremas nurgas leentool, sellest vasemal kirjutuslaud, millel lebavad paremal pool tuhatoos piibuga, raamat ja telefoniaparaat; vasakul pool vaas pintslitega, statuett, pudelikene ja sinise draperii peal palett. Draperii ulatub maani. Aknalaual laevamudel. Laua taga näha raadioaparaat, millel seisab küünlajalg. Selle taga raamatukapp, millel seisab gloobus. Vasakul seinal ripuvad kaks kullaraamis maali, millest ülemine kujutab seltsimees Lenini portreed; alumisel kunstniku autoportree.
8189.de: In the right corner an armchair, to the left of it a writing desk, on which lie, on the right side, an ashtray with a pipe, a book and a telephone apparatus; on the left side a vase with brushes, a statuette, a small bottle and a palette on a blue drapery. The drapery reaches to the floor. On the windowsill a ship model. Behind the desk a radio apparatus is visible, on which stands a candlestick. Behind that a bookcase, on which stands a globe. On the left wall hang two gilt-framed paintings, of which the upper depicts a portrait of comrade Lenin; the lower one the artist's self-portrait.

8192.d: Esiplaanil paremal - paberil kalad, nuga, väike juustupakk. Vasakul - piip ja tuhatoos. Sinisel linal juusturatas, selle kõrval piimakann, klaas ja konservikarp.
8192.de: In the foreground on the right - fish, a knife, a small package of cheese on paper. On the left - a pipe and an ashtray. On a blue cloth, a wheel of cheese, next to it a milk jug, a glass and a tin can.

8209.d: Vaade Tallinna vanalinna (Tolli) tänavale. Kitsaste, punaste viilkatustega majade tagant paistab väike osas Oleviste kiriku tornist. Majade varjud langevad sõiduteele. Paremal, paistamas ristuva Laia tänava päikesest valgustatud heledad hooned.
8209.de: View of (Tolli) Street in Tallinn's Old Town. Behind the narrow, red gable-roofed houses a small part of the tower of St Olaf's Church (Oleviste) is visible. The shadows of the houses fall onto the roadway. On the right, the sun-lit bright buildings of the intersecting Lai Street are visible.

8221.d: Lumiste puude vahel rehielamu päikselise talveilmaga. Taluhoonete vahel teel naine valge põllega. Realistlik kujutamisviis.
8221.de: A threshing barn dwelling among snowy trees in sunny winter weather. On the path between the farm buildings a woman in a white apron. Realistic manner of depiction.

8224.d: Vanema naise rinnafiguur rohelises kleidis, käes sinised lilled. Taamal veekogu ja stiliseeritud maastik. Paremal alumises nurgas hundinuiad.
8224.de: Bust of an elderly woman in a green dress, holding blue flowers. In the distance a body of water and a stylised landscape. In the lower right corner, cattails.

8321.d: Keskel rohekas-halli metsaga kaetud nõgu, mida ümbritseb külgedel ja tagaplaanil hall mäeahelik.
8321.de: In the middle a hollow covered with greenish-grey forest, surrounded on the sides and in the background by a grey mountain range.

8364.d: Esiplaanil seisva mehe kolmveerandfiguur toetumas tooli najale. Paremas käes piip, vasak toetub tooli korjule. Vasakul laud paberite ja trükilaokastidega. Taga vasakul varjus näha seisva mehe figuur pruunis kitlis seljaga vaataja poole.
8364.de: Three-quarter figure of a man standing in the foreground, leaning on the back of a chair. In his right hand a pipe, his left hand resting on the chair frame. On the left a table with papers and printer's type-cases. In the background on the left, in shadow, the figure of a standing man in a brown smock, his back to the viewer.

8386.d: Tuba, tagaservas lai aken, mille ees seisev naine maalib. Vasakul klaver, paremal laud, selle ääres vanem istuv naine. Akna lähedal kolm last.
8386.de: A room, at the back a wide window, in front of which a standing woman is painting. On the left a piano, on the right a table, beside it an older sitting woman. Near the window three children.

8401.d: Kõrvuni lühikeseks lõigatud tumedate juustega vana naise rinnakujutus otsevaates. Katmata pea, juuksed paremal lahku kammitud. Tõsine, mõtteisse süvanenud ilme. Sinakas pluus, ülekoloriit beežikas - hall, laiad pintslitõmbed.(eesti)
8401.de: Bust portrait of an old woman with dark hair cropped short up to the ears, in frontal view. Bare head, hair parted on the right. Serious, pensive expression. Bluish blouse, overall colouring beige-grey, broad brushstrokes.

8416.d: Paremal jõgi, vasakul esiplaanil jõe kallas, mille ääres paadisild hulga inimeste ja paatidega. Silla juures pikk lipuvarras punase lipuga. Üle jõe näha tihe rohtunud kallas, mille taga mets.
8416.de: On the right a river, on the left in the foreground the riverbank, along which a pontoon bridge with a number of people and boats. By the bridge a tall flagpole with a red flag. Across the river a dense grassy bank is visible, with a forest behind it.

8424.d: Vanema mehe pea otsevaates, peas läkiläki, kaela ümber karusnahast krae.
8424.de: Head of an older man in frontal view, wearing a lakilaki on his head, a fur collar around his neck.

8524.d: Keskplaanil visandlikult maalitud kaks punaste katustega valget ja nende vahel kollane hoone. Kõrval lillades toonides puud. Esiplaanil punakas-pruunikas tee. Taevas helesinine. Kohati on värvipinna alt näha aluspapil olevat teksti.
8524.de: In the middle ground, sketchily painted, two white buildings with red roofs and a yellow building between them. Trees in purple tones beside them. In the foreground a reddish-brown road. Sky light blue. In places text on the underlying cardboard is visible beneath the paint layer.

8539.d: Lillakal foonil tüseda, roosade põskede ning tumedate, veidi laines juustega naise otsevaates rinnaportree. Seljas must, seosega kleit ja õlgadel valge sall.
8539.de: Against a lilac background, a frontal bust portrait of a stout woman with rosy cheeks and dark, slightly wavy hair. Wearing a black, patterned dress and a white shawl on her shoulders.

8627.d: Lillakas rõivastuses noore naise õlgadeni portree veerandpöördes vasakule.
8627.de: Shoulder-length portrait of a young woman in purplish clothing, in a quarter-turn to the left.

8629.d: Noore mehe poolfiguur istuvas asendis kerges pöördes paremale. Valge särk, pruun kittel. Pintsel paremas, palett vasakus käes.
8629.de: Half-figure of a young man in a seated position, turned slightly to the right. White shirt, brown smock. Brush in the right hand, palette in the left.

8683.d: Mehe poolfiguur klaasilihvimispingi juures. Käes kristallvaas.
8683.de: Half-figure of a man at a glass-grinding bench. Holding a crystal vase.

8692.d: Esiplaanil lumine tee, mis läheb diagonaalselt paremale. Kahel pool tee ääres puud ja põõsad. Pildi keskosas teel kaks hobust reedega. Paremal taluhoone. Teest vasakul tagaplaanil puude vahelt paistmas teine hoone.
8692.de: In the foreground a snowy road leading diagonally to the right. On both sides of the road trees and bushes. In the middle of the picture on the road two horses with a sleigh. On the right a farm building. To the left of the road, in the background, another building visible among the trees.

8709.d: Esiplaanil õu, millel ristuvad kividest laotud teerajad. Keskplaanil vana lossiehitus trepi, võlvialuse ja punasest kivist katusega. Päikesest valgustatud osa ja varjukülg teravalt rõhutatud. Ülaservast paistab kitsas taevariba.(eesti)
8709.de: In the foreground a courtyard with crossing stone-paved paths. In the middle ground an old castle building with a staircase, an archway and a roof of red brick. The sunlit part and the shaded side are sharply emphasised. From the upper edge a narrow strip of sky is visible.

8880.d: Noore sinises kleidis naise rindportree otsevaates. Tukaga sirged lühikesed pruunid juuksed.
8880.de: Bust portrait of a young woman in a blue dress, frontal view. Straight short brown hair with a fringe.

8881.d: Esiplaanil laud viinamarjadega taldrikul, mille kõrval vasakul arbuus, paremal pruun vaas ja klaasist karahvin. Lauast kõrgemal näha alumine osa avatud aknast. Vasakul aknalaual roheline kann ja punased piprakaunad.
8881.de: In the foreground a table with grapes on a plate, next to it on the left a watermelon, on the right a brown vase and a glass carafe. Above the table the lower part of an open window is visible. On the left on the windowsill a green jug and red pepper pods.

8907.d: Ees paremal naine imikuga, ta kõrval laua otsas mees ja vasakul kolm last. Laua keskel savikauss puulusikatega.(eesti)
8907.de: In front on the right a woman with an infant, beside her at the end of the table a man and on the left three children. In the middle of the table a clay bowl with wooden spoons.

8940.d: Maali keskosas kaks inimest valgetes kitlites ja mütsides operatsiooni teostamas. Nende ees sinises kleidis, valges põlles ja tanus naine selgvaates istumas, ümberringi hulk inimesi. Paremas nurgas alusega pesukauss ja arstiriistade trummel alusega. Vasakus nurgas naine valges kitlis ja tanus otsevaates pudelit käes hoidmas.
8940.de: In the centre of the painting two people in white coats and caps performing an operation. In front of them, in full view, a woman in a blue dress, white apron and bonnet, sitting, surrounded by a number of people. In the right corner a washbasin on a stand and a drum of surgical instruments on a stand. In the left corner a woman in a white coat and bonnet, in frontal view, holding a bottle.

8959.d: Patsidega tütarlapse rinnaportree poolpöördes paremale. Nägu en face. Foon sinakas.
8959.de: Bust portrait of a girl with braids, in half-turn to the right. Face en face. Background bluish.

8986.d: Istuv naine poolprofiilil paremale. Käed rüpes. Vasaku rinna kohal kaks medalit. Peas valge rätik.
8986.de: A seated woman in half-profile to the right. Hands in her lap. Above her left breast two medals. A white kerchief on her head.

9154.d: Istuva noore naise poolfiguur. Pea otsevaates, keha kerges pöördes paremale. Seljas tume kirju hommikumantel.
9154.de: Half-figure of a seated young woman. Head in frontal view, body slightly turned to the right. Wearing a dark patterned morning gown.

9165.d: Lesiva noore blondi naise poolfiguur kerges pöördes vasakule. Kirjuruuduline jakk, helehall seelik. Selja tagant paistab kapp, paremalt äärelt lõuendi serv.
9165.de: Half-figure of a reclining young blonde woman in a slight turn to the left. A checkered jacket, light grey skirt. Behind her back a cupboard is visible, on the right edge the edge of the canvas.

9237.d: Esiplaanil suured kivid mererannal. Paremal meri. vasakul taga kõrge paekallas ja puud ning põõsad, nende keskel näha sõiduauto.(eesti)
9237.de: In the foreground large rocks on the seashore. On the right the sea. On the left behind, a high limestone bank and trees and bushes, among which a car can be seen. (Estonian)

9250.d: Esiplaanil vasakul hallis kleidis naine võrku parandamas, kaks meest ja kaks naist vintsi juures töötamas. Vasakul telliskivipunases seelikus valge rätiga naine võrke kuivama panemas. Taamal sinine veekogu, mille liivasel kaldal purjepaadid.
9250.de: In the foreground on the left, a woman in a grey dress mending a net, two men and two women working at a winch. On the left, a woman in a brick-red skirt with a white kerchief hanging nets out to dry. Beyond, a blue body of water, with sailboats on its sandy shore.

9369.d: Esiplaanil vanalinna punased viilkatused, paremal paistab raekoja torn ja televisioonimast. Vasakul taga lahesopp sadama ja kraanadega.
9369.de: In the foreground the red gable roofs of the old town, on the right the town hall tower and a television mast are visible. On the left in the background a bay with a harbour and cranes.

9404.d: Istuva naise poolfiguur otsevaates, pea kergelt vasakule pööratud. Käed süles. Sinisekirju pluus, roosakirju põll.
9404.de: Half-figure of a seated woman in frontal view, head turned slightly to the left. Hands in her lap. Blue-patterned blouse, pinkish-patterned apron.

9417.d: Noor tütarlaps otsevaates istuvas asendis, käed asetatud põlvedele, käte vahel raamat. Tumedad käharad juuksed lahuga keskel, hallikassinine pluus ja kootud vest.
9417.de: A young girl seated, in frontal view, hands placed on her knees, a book between her hands. Dark curly hair parted in the middle, a greyish-blue blouse and a knitted vest.

9446.d: Järve kaldal keskel ja paremal metsa ääres talumajad sinatavate korstendega. Keskplaanil nõlvak, silmapiiril mets. Hele koloriit.
9446.de: On the shore of a lake, in the middle and on the right at the edge of a forest, farmhouses with bluish chimneys. In the middle ground a slope, on the horizon a forest. Light colouring.

9456.d: Naise portree 3/4 profiilis vasakule. Seljas sile must kleit kraega. Juuksed siledalt kammitud.
9456.de: Portrait of a woman in 3/4 profile to the left. Wearing a smooth black dress with a collar. Hair combed smoothly.

9459.d: Seisva naise poolfiguur otsevaates. Prillid, seljas hall kittel. Paremas käes kimp pintsleid.
9459.de: Half-figure of a standing woman in frontal view. Glasses, wearing a grey smock. In her right hand a bundle of brushes.

9547.d: Esiplaanil raagus puuvõre. Tagaplaanil vaade kivimajadele. Talviselt sompus taevas.
9547.de: In the foreground a bare tree lattice. In the background a view of stone houses. Wintry, gloomy sky.

9566.d: Esiplaanil lai rukkipõld. Keskplaanil peaaegu maali keskel rukkipõldude vahel veoauto. Veoauto kastist paistavad kaks naisepead ja pika varre otsas lehviv punane lipp. tagaplaanil maanteel kaks veomasinat ja kolm poisikest. Nendest paremal asuval põllul rukkilõikusmasin ja tütarlaps jalgrattaga käe kõrval.
9566.de: In the foreground a wide rye field. In the middle ground, almost at the centre of the painting, a truck among the rye fields. From the truck bed two women's heads and a red flag fluttering on a long pole can be seen. In the background on the road two harvesting machines and three boys. In the field to their right a rye harvester and a girl with a bicycle by her hand.

9574.d: Vasakul pikk, õlgkatusega rehielamu; sellest paremal suur puu, kelder ja osa õlgkatusega kõrvalhoonest. Keldri poolt tuleb naine esiplaanil vasakul asetseva pika laua poole, mille ümber istub grupp inimesi.
9574.de: On the left a long, thatched-roof threshing barn dwelling; to its right a large tree, a cellar and part of a thatched-roof outbuilding. From the cellar a woman comes toward a long table in the foreground on the left, around which a group of people is sitting.

9636.d: Avatud uksel seisab poiss uisud paremal õlal. Vasakus käes kepp. Seljas tume palitu, pikad pruunid püksid. Peas kõrvadega talimüts, käes kindad.
9636.de: A boy stands in an open doorway with skates on his right shoulder. A cane in his left hand. Wearing a dark coat, long brown trousers. On his head a winter hat with ear flaps, gloves in hand.

9653.d: Lapse portree 3/4 pöördes vasakule. Tumedad juuksed, pruunid silmad, valge pluus.
9653.de: Portrait of a child in 3/4 turn facing left. Dark hair, brown eyes, white blouse.

9750.d: Tumesinisel veekogul neli paati sõitmas, vasakul kalda ääres kaks purjekat seismas. Esiplaanil vasakul purjekas kolme mehega. Keskel punane paadinina ja selle kohale kummarduva mehe pea roosa tuttmütsiga. Vasakul kollane paat naise ja mehega, kellel käes aerud.
9750.de: Four boats sailing on a dark blue body of water, two sailboats standing on the shore on the left. In the foreground on the left a sailboat with three men. In the middle a red bow of a boat and above it the head of a man bending over, wearing a pink tufted cap. On the left a yellow boat with a woman and a man holding oars.

9755.d: Esiplaanil kaks naist valgete pearättikutega võrke parandamas. Tagapool vasakul paat, mille poole kaks meest minemas. Üks kannab midagi õlal, teine kaenla all. Taamal tumesinine meri valge purjekaga.
9755.de: In the foreground two women with white headscarves mending nets. Further back on the left a boat, towards which two men are walking. One is carrying something on his shoulder, the other under his arm. In the distance a dark blue sea with a white sailboat.

9813.d: Punase lava taga seisev mees loeb ette üleskutset. Temast paremal istub laua taga nokkmütsiga mees ja kirjutab valgele paberile. Teda varjab osaliselt laua parema serva ääres seisev mees, kes vasaku käega nõjatub lauale. Seisva mehe paremat jalga varjab pink. Pingi taga näha kolme naist ja üks mees. Lauast vasakul pool 12 inimest osalt istudes, osalt seistes; kuulamas üleskutset. Nendest esiplaanil oleval pingil istuvad valge särgi ja talimütsiga mees ja punase rätikuga naine. Inimeste rühma tagant paistab aken. Akna ja värava vahel oleval seinal ripub plakat.
9813.de: A man standing behind a red stage reads out an appeal. To his right a man wearing a peaked cap sits at a table and writes on a white sheet of paper. He is partly obscured by a man standing at the right edge of the table, leaning on the table with his left hand. The standing man's right leg is obscured by a bench. Behind the bench three women and one man can be seen. To the left of the table 12 people, some sitting, some standing, listening to the appeal. Of these, on the bench in the foreground sit a man in a white shirt and winter cap and a woman with a red kerchief. Behind the group of people a window can be seen. On the wall between the window and the gate hangs a poster.

9837.d: Valge linaga kaetud ümmargune laud, millel tordid, puuviljad, lilled, taldrikud, veinikarahvin ja klaasid.
9837.de: A round table covered with a white cloth, on which are cakes, fruit, flowers, plates, a wine decanter, and glasses.

9866.d: Madalal järil istuva mehe täisfiguur pooleldi selgvaates madala, raamatutega kaetud laua ääres. Vasakul tool paberitega. Laua ja tooli taga põrandal lõuendeid, paremal pudel. Koloriit rohekas-hall.
9866.de: Full figure of a man sitting on a low stool, shown half-frontally, at a low table covered with books. On the left a chair with papers. Behind the table and chair on the floor canvases, on the right a bottle. The colouring is greenish-grey.

9897.d: Laual taldrik, sinine piimakann, kõrvits ja pott suurelehelise lillega.
9897.de: On the table a plate, a blue milk jug, a pumpkin and a pot with a large-leaved flower.

9910.d: Heledas kleidis patsidega tütarlapse täisfiguur seljaga vaataja poole. Parem käsi tõstetud. Figuur ja foon valgustatud hõõguvpunase lavaprožektoriga.
9910.de: Full figure of a girl with braids in a light-coloured dress, seen from behind. Right hand raised. The figure and background lit by a glowing red stage spotlight.

9917.d: Noormehe rindportree 3/4 pöördes paremale. Pruunid juuksed ja silmad, hele särk.(eesti)
9917.de: Bust portrait of a young man in 3/4 turn to the right. Brown hair and eyes, light-coloured shirt.

9999.d: Esiplaanil pruun ümar vaas suure kimbu kollaste kullerkuppudega, osa kullerkuppude kroonlehtedest pudenemas. Foon tumeroheline, paremalt pisut heledam.(eesti)
9999.de: In the foreground a brown round vase with a large bunch of yellow marsh marigolds, some of the marsh marigolds' petals falling off. The background dark green, slightly lighter on the right.

10000.d: Roosakais-lillakais toonides visandlik maastikupilt puudesalu ning lagendikuga. Keskplaanil vasakul lilla puuderühm, paremal üksik roheline puu. Esiplaan oranzides pruunikates toonides. Lillakas-roosas taevas kollased päikeseviirud.
10000.de: A sketchy landscape in pinkish-lilac tones with a grove of trees and a clearing. In the middle ground on the left a lilac group of trees, on the right a solitary green tree. Foreground in orange-brownish tones. Lilac-pink sky with yellow streaks of sunlight.

10063.d: Keskel helendava veepinnaga, kalda ääres türkiisisnise veega järv. Järvest tõusevad kaljused sinised mäed, mis silmapiirini välja vahelduvad orgudega. Esiplaanil vasakul ja paremal on kaljude kivine pind antud lähivaates hallides ja pruunides toonides. Ülal kollakasvalgete suurte pilvedega taevas.(eesti)
10063.de: In the middle a lake with a glowing water surface, turquoise-blue water near the shore. From the lake rise rocky blue mountains, alternating with valleys all the way to the horizon. In the foreground on the left and right the rocky surface of the cliffs is given in close view in grey and brown tones. Above, a sky with large yellowish-white clouds.

10138.d: Istuv poiss pöördes vasakule. Põlvedel kollane raamat, mida hoiab kätega. Sinised püksid ja kampsun.
10138.de: Sitting boy turned to the left. A yellow book on his knees, held with his hands. Blue trousers and jumper.

10140.d: Esiplaanil keskel neli mändi. Mändide all ja Mändidest vasakule puisniidul lambakari. Taga vasakul küngas, paremal veepinna riba.(eesti)
10140.de: In the centre foreground four pines. Under the pines and to the left of the pines on the wooded meadow a flock of sheep. Behind, on the left a hill, on the right a strip of water surface.

10154.d: Istuva tütarlapse poolfiguur pöördes paremal. Kirju tume kleit, tukaga heledad juuksed, käed süles.
10154.de: Half-figure of a seated girl turned to the right. Colourful dark dress, light hair with a fringe, hands in lap.

10155.d: Noore istuva naise poolfiguur otsevaates. Käsivarred põlvedel. Lühikesed juuksed, sinine kleit, hall kampsun, foon hall.
10155.de: Half-figure of a young seated woman in frontal view. Forearms on the knees. Short hair, blue dress, grey jumper, grey background.

10165.d: Kirju riidega kaetud astmelisel alusel rohekas vaas, laualamp rohelise abažuuriga, roosa kauss, kaks pudelit jm. Taustal osa aknast, paksudes voltides langeva eesriidega. Intensiivsed värvid pruunil foonil.
10165.de: On a stepped base covered with a patterned cloth, a greenish vase, a table lamp with a green lampshade, a pink bowl, two bottles etc. In the background, part of a window with a curtain falling in thick folds. Intense colours on a brown background.

10322.d: Puudega piiratud lagendik, kus esiplaanil punased lehmad, vasakul tütarlapse figuur. Eemalt puude vahelt paistavad majakatused.
10322.de: A clearing bordered by trees, with red cows in the foreground and a girl's figure on the left. House roofs visible in the distance through the trees.

10361.d: Rahvarõivas laulupeoliste rongkäik liikumas vaataja suunas. Tagaplaanil "Estonia" ja "Draamateatri" hooned.
10361.de: A procession of Song Festival participants in folk costume moving towards the viewer. In the background the "Estonia" and "Draamateater" buildings.

10381.d: Mustades, sinistes, kollastes toonides taustal punased inimfiguurid. (eesti)
10381.de: Red human figures against a background in black, blue, and yellow tones.

10424.d: Erksates värvides linnavaade, majade ees kaldale tõmmatud paadid, taustal rohekas sinine mägi helerohelise taeva all.
10424.de: A cityscape in vivid colours, boats pulled up on the shore in front of the houses, a greenish blue mountain in the background under a light green sky.

10429.d: Kaks eksootilise välimusega, pikas riietuses naist kandmas õlal vaase. Üks otsevaates, teine seljaga vaataja poole.Taustal valged lameda katusega majad. (eesti)
10429.de: Two exotic-looking women in long garments carrying vases on their shoulders. One facing the viewer directly, the other with her back to the viewer. In the background white flat-roofed houses.

10561.d: Ergastes toonides kubistlikus laadis maal, mille keskosas kaks, üldistatult kujutatud figuuri. Vasakpoolsel peas silmi varjav kübar, käes valge kinnas. Parempoolsel lühikesed juuksed, õlgadel türkiissinise varjundiga rõivaese. Esiplaanil pruunikas abstraktne vorm, millel sinakas puuviljakorv, peekritaoline ese, kuhjas dokumendid ja pruuni värvi kinnas. Maalimise käigus on värvi kraabitud mustreid ja kujundeid. Kujutiste piirjooni markeerivad kohad kergelt pastoossed.
10561.de: A painting in vivid tones in a cubist style, with two generalised figures in the central part. The left-hand figure has a hat covering the eyes, a white glove in the hand. The right-hand figure has short hair, a garment with a turquoise-blue tinge on the shoulders. In the foreground a brownish abstract form, on which is a bluish fruit basket, a goblet-like object, a pile of documents, and a brown-coloured glove. In the process of painting, patterns and shapes have been scraped into the paint. The places marking the outlines of the images are slightly impasto.

10565.d: Rohelisel taustal, sinist mütsi kandva, kätega pead toetava  tumedajuukselise naise rindportree. Pea kergelt paremale kallutatud, käed toetatud lauale, millel tass ja raamatulaadne ese.
10565.de: Against a green background, a bust portrait of a dark-haired woman wearing a blue cap, holding her head with her hands. Head slightly tilted to the right, hands resting on a table on which there is a cup and a book-like object.

10567.d: Eri varjundites sinisel taustal pruunis toonis hallide, tahakammitud juustega mehe rindportree pöördes vasakule. Valge kaelusega sinine riietus. Ekspressiivne laad, pind siin-seal jäetud läbimaalimata.
10567.de: Against a background of various shades of blue, a brown-toned bust portrait of a man with grey, combed-back hair, turned to the left. Blue clothing with a white collar. Expressive style, the surface left unpainted in places.

10568.d: Väikeste pintslilöökidega antud, veekogu kaldal tumerohelise põõsastiku najale toetuv heleda pearätikuga punases riietuses istuva naise täisfiguur. Käes kalavõrk, paremal liivase rannaga veekogu ääres kaks paati. Maali aluspind kohati läbikumav, naise salli ja kalavõrgu struktuur antud värvipinda kraabitud sälkudena.
10568.de: Given with small brushstrokes, the full figure of a woman in red clothing with a light headscarf, sitting by a body of water leaning against dark green shrubbery. A fishing net in her hands, on the right two boats by the sandy shore of the water. The painting's surface is partly translucent, the structure of the woman's scarf and the fishing net rendered as notches scratched into the paint layer.

10572.d: Pastelsetes toonides, rohekas-sinakal foonil geometriseeritud, abstraktsena mõjuv kompositsioon. Vasakul liikuvat figuuri meenutav, ekspressiivsete pintslilöökidega antud kujutis, millel justkui käed üles pea kohale tõstetud, mustad juuksesalgud lehvimas. Nägu markeerib roosakas-lillal foonil mustaga antud silma kujutis. Paremal ülal nurgas kollane ring.
10572.de: A composition in pastel tones, geometrized against a greenish-bluish background, giving an abstract impression. On the left, an image resembling a moving figure, rendered with expressive brushstrokes, as if with hands raised above the head, black strands of hair fluttering. The face is marked, against a pinkish-purple background, by a depiction of an eye given in black. In the upper right corner a yellow circle.

10577.d: Sinakasrohelise taevaga üksikute puuvõradega soomaastik kolme veesilmaga, paremal nurgas kaks lendavat lindu.
10577.de: A bog landscape in bluish-green sky with solitary tree crowns and three pools of water, in the right corner two flying birds.

10578.d: Esiplaanil rohelisel niidul seisev roosa rätikuga naine silitamas varssa. Nende taga kolm hobust.
10578.de: In the foreground a woman with a pink headscarf standing on a green meadow, stroking a foal. Behind them three horses.

10602.d: Kaksikportree elegantselt riietatud vanemast- ja noorest naisest. Maalitud lakoonilises laadis, foon oranžides-pruunides toonides.
10602.de: Double portrait of an elegantly dressed older and young woman. Painted in a laconic style, background in orange-brown tones.

10647.d: Natüürmort pudeli, lillevaasi, kala ja kolme sidruniga heledal linal. Maalitud kuivalt ja viimistletud kraapimistehnikas.
10647.de: Still life with a bottle, flower vase, fish and three lemons on a light-colored cloth. Painted dry and finished in a scraping technique.

10649.d: Tugitoolis istuva noore naise otsevaates portree. Naisel peas müts, seljas mantel ja käes kindad, taust tumepunane.
10649.de: Frontal portrait of a young woman sitting in an armchair. The woman wears a hat, a coat and gloves, the background is dark red.

10709.d: Esiplaanil paremal kahe naisterahva rindportree veerandpöördes vasakule.
10709.de: In the foreground on the right, bust portrait of two women in a quarter-turn to the left.

10713.d: Noore mehe portree kerges pöördes paremale. Seljas triibuline hommikumantel ja suure kaelusega särk. Taust akvarellitud pruunikaks.
10713.de: Portrait of a young man in a slight turn to the right. Wearing a striped dressing gown and a shirt with a large collar. Background watercoloured brownish.

10714.d: Noore mehe ekspressiivne portree otsevaates. Nägu maalitud lillades, sinistes ja roosades toonides, seljas punane särk ja pruun üleriie. Taust jaotatud horisontaalselt kollaseks ja siniseks pinnaks.
10714.de: Expressive portrait of a young man in frontal view. The face painted in purple, blue and pink tones, wearing a red shirt and a brown overcoat. The background divided horizontally into a yellow and a blue field.

10726.d: Türkiissinistes toonides abstraktne kompositsioon pastelsete lillade ja kollaste pindadega. Teose keskel ümaramad, servades kandilisemad vormid.
10726.de: An abstract composition in turquoise-blue tones with pastel purple and yellow surfaces. In the centre of the work rounder forms, more angular at the edges.

10727.d: Teose keskmes beežis, pruunis ning türkiissinises koloriidis abstraktne ebasümmeetriline ruudustik, mida ümbritseb servadest beež pind. Kompositsioonist joonistuvad tinglikult välja inimfiguuri rindportree piirjooned.

10741.dm: laius: 87.0 cm; kõrgus: 97.5 cm (Mõõdud raamita. Raamiga mõõdud: 104x95 cm)
10741.d: Istuva heledas kleidis naise poolfiguurportree pöördega vasakule. Naisel heledad juuksed, tukaga soeng, käes pikad kindad. Käsitluslaad üldistav, tumedate kontuuridega, taust rohekas.
10741.de: Half-figure portrait of a seated woman in a light-coloured dress, turned to the left. The woman has light hair, a hairstyle with a fringe, and holds long gloves in her hand. Treatment style generalising, with dark contours, background greenish.

10742.dm: laius: 82.5 cm; kõrgus: 155.0 cm (Mõõdud raamita. Raamiga mõõdud 162 x 89,5 cm.)
10742.d: Rohekates toonides geometriseeritud abstraktsioon. Kompositsioon jaotatud vertikaalseteks värvipindadeks, teostatud osaliselt pahtelmaali tehnikas.
10742.de: A geometricized abstraction in greenish tones. The composition is divided into vertical colour planes, partly executed in the impasto technique.

10748.d: Otsevaates rindportree noorest naisest heleda lühikese soenguga. Figuuril seljas valge kampsun, taust koosneb tumedatest pindadest.
10748.de: Frontal bust portrait of a young woman with light-coloured short hairstyle. The figure wears a white jumper, the background consists of dark planes.

10750.d: Visandlik otsevaates rindportree noorest naisest. Tausta parem pind koosneb vahelduvatest sinistest ja mustadest joontest.
10750.de: Sketchy frontal bust portrait of a young woman. The right surface of the background consists of alternating blue and black lines.

10787.d: Keskel rohelistes toonides kaks ovaalideks stiliseeritud teineteist embavat inimfiguuri, kehaliikmed üksteisesse sulavad. Foon roheline, figuuride ümber kollakalt helendav.
10787.de: In the centre, in green tones, two human figures stylised into ovals embracing each other, their limbs merging into one another. Background green, glowing yellowish around the figures.

10788.d: Allservas kolmnurksete ogadega kaetud rull, millest (nagu kangas kangarullilt) keerdub spiraalselt üles tee-kujund. Hoogsalt keerduva spiraali lõpetab kolme tolmukaga õiekrooni meenutav kujund. Maalitud sügavates pruunides toonides, siin-seal heledamaid toone läbi kumada lastes.
10788.de: At the lower edge a roller covered with triangular spikes, from which (like fabric from a loom's roller) a road-shaped form spirals upward. The vigorously coiling spiral ends in a form resembling a flower crown with three stamens. Painted in deep brown tones, allowing lighter tones to shine through here and there.

10789.d: Hõõguval punasel taustal keskel palvetav, põlvili laskunud figuur. Käed näo ette tõstetud, küünarnukid põlvede kohal koos. Figuur tumedates rohelistes toonides. Fooni servades markeeritakse mõne tumeda joonega interjööri.
10789.de: On a glowing red background, in the centre, a praying figure kneeling down. Hands raised before the face, elbows together above the knees. Figure in dark green tones. At the edges of the background, an interior is indicated with a few dark lines.

10790.d: Keskel hallides ja pruunides toonides pöörist meenutav kujund, milles on vaevu aimata kaht teineteisesse sulanud figuuri. Foon pruun.
10790.de: In the centre, in grey and brown tones, a whirl-like form in which two figures merged into one another can barely be discerned. Brown background.

10791.d: Keskel kaks tugevasti stiliseeritud teineteist embavat inimfiguuri tantsiskleval sammul astumas. Kummagi figuuri pead meenutavas kehaosas üks silm, jalad ja käed vormitud, kaani meenutavad. Foon hoogsate pintslilöökidega maalitud, kollastes toonides. Figuurid tumepruunid.
10791.de: In the middle, two strongly stylised human figures embracing each other, stepping in a dancing motion. In the body part resembling a head of each figure, one eye, the legs and arms formed resembling flippers. The background painted with vigorous brushstrokes, in yellow tones. The figures dark brown.

10792.d: Keskel spiraalina ülespoole keerduv roosakais toonides suitsuvinet meenutav kujund. Hallist foonist kumab läbi roosa alusvärv.
10792.de: In the middle a spiral shape twisting upwards, resembling smoke haze in pinkish tones. A pink base colour shines through the grey background.

10793.d: Keskel ovaalideks stiliseeritud põlvitav inimfiguur. Vormitud käed lõpevad meandri-kujundiga. Vasakult figuurile langev valgus tekitab figuuri taga väikese ovaalse varju. Foon lillakashall, alt kumavad läbi roosad toonid.
10793.de: In the centre a kneeling human figure stylised into ovals. The moulded hands end in a meander-shaped form. Light falling on the figure from the left creates a small oval shadow behind the figure. Background lilac-grey, pink tones shimmering through from below.

10794.d: Keskel pruunides toonides kaks teineteist embavat stiliseeritud inimfiguuri. Kehavormid ovaalsed, üksteisesse sulavad. Foon hall, alt kumab läbi roosa toon.
10794.de: In the centre, in brown tones, two stylised human figures embracing each other. Body forms oval, merging into one another. Background grey, a pink tone shining through from below.

10798.d: Lühikeste tumedate juustega noore naise rinnaportree otsevaates: naisel seljas sinise kraega pluus ja punakaspruun jakk, pilk pisut vaatajast mööda ja alla suunatud, väike punane hästi vormitud suu. Foon rohekaskollastes ja ookritoonides.
10798.de: A frontal chest portrait of a young woman with short dark hair: the woman wears a blouse with a blue collar and a reddish-brown jacket, her gaze directed slightly past the viewer and downward, a small, well-formed red mouth. The background is in greenish-yellow and ochre tones.

10802.d: Tumedal lillakal taustal istuv stiliseeritud naisfiguur otsevaates. Paremale küünarvarrele toetuv ülakeha, vasak käsi üle teise. Pea viltukallutatud, kurblik pilk suunatud üles. Tumeda kontuurjoonega ümardatud pehmed vormid.
10802.de: A stylised female figure seated against a dark purplish background, in frontal view. Upper body resting on the right forearm, left hand over the other. Head tilted to the side, sorrowful gaze directed upward. Soft rounded forms with a dark contour line.

10803.d: Punase padjaga leentoolis istuv väike tüdruk otsevaates, vasak jalg istmiku all, pea viltu. Tüdrukul heledad pikad juuksed seotud sabasse, seljas helekollased põlvpüksid ja sviiter. Nõtke skitseeriv maalilaad.
10803.de: A small girl sitting in an armchair with a red cushion, seen frontally, left leg tucked under her, head tilted. The girl has light-coloured long hair tied in a ponytail, wearing pale yellow knee-length trousers and a sweater. Supple, sketch-like painting style.

10809.d: Tumedates rohelistes ja pruunides toonides sürrealistlik, moonutatud inimfiguur. Pea ja kõht stiliseeritud neerukujulisteks, jalad puuduvad. Üsast paiskub välja tohutu sooniline, kõverdatud sõrmadega käsi. Kujutisele ülalt vasakult langev valgus kumab vastu käel ja kehal, jätab paremale väikese varju. Foon alt roheline, ülalt soojades toonides pruun.
10809.de: A surrealist, distorted human figure in dark green and brown tones. Head and belly stylized into kidney-like shapes, legs missing. A huge sinewy hand with curved fingers bursts out of the womb. Light falling on the image from upper left gleams on the hand and body, leaving a small shadow on the right. Background green from below, warm brown tones from above.

10810.d: Tumepruunides toonides figuraalne kompositsioon. Keskel istub tumedas rüüs habemik noor mees, käelabad põlvedele toetatud. Jeesuse ümber hulk lapsi, kaks neist põlvedel (parampoolne katsub Jeesuse nägu). Ülal foonil kollastes toonides kiudpilvedega taevas.
10810.de: A figural composition in dark brown tones. In the middle sits a bearded young man in dark robes, hands resting on his knees. Around Jesus a number of children, two of them on his knees (the one on the right touching Jesus's face). Above, in the background, a sky in yellow tones with fibrous clouds.

10811.d: Tumedates pruunides toonides kiriku interjöör: keskel, ristilöödupildiga altari ees pastor, parem käsi kõnehoos välja sirutatud, suu lahti. Altariruumi piiravatel pinkidel kirikulised, osa neist (allservas) seljaga, teised küljega vaataja poole. Altaril kaks põlevat küünalt. Paremal, kooriruumi seinal kõrge kitsa akna kõrval kolme küünlaga seinabraa.
10811.de: A church interior in dark brown tones: in the centre, a pastor in front of an altar with a crucifixion image, right hand outstretched in a speaking gesture, mouth open. Churchgoers on the pews bordering the altar area, some of them (in the lower edge) with their backs turned, others sideways to the viewer. Two burning candles on the altar. On the right, next to a tall narrow window on the chancel wall, a three-candle wall sconce.

10816.d: Istuva noore naise portree. Keha veerandpöördes paremale, nägu vaatab otse. Figuur kannab valget avatud kitlit, sinist seelikut ja värvilist pluusi. Taustal lilla draperii.
10816.de: Portrait of a seated young woman. Body in a quarter-turn to the right, face looking straight ahead. The figure wears a white open smock, a blue skirt and a coloured blouse. In the background, a purple drapery.

10820.d: Värvikirev abstraktne kompositsioon, maalitud lühikeste tihedate pintslilöökidega - üksikud kontuurid on välja toodud musta peene pintslijoonega.
10820.de: A colourful abstract composition, painted with short dense brushstrokes - individual contours are brought out with a thin black brush line.

10846.d: Kummalistest, maskitaoliste nägudega figuuridest tantsuring. Osa mütoloogilistest olevustest lendleb õhus, pildi alumistes nurkades tillukesed figuurid.
10846.de: A dance circle of strange, mask-like faced figures. Some of the mythological creatures float in the air, tiny figures in the lower corners of the picture.

10868.d: Kõrgendikult alla vaatav maastikuvaade järvele ja metsadega kaetud järvakaldale ja saarekestele. Puude lehestik on kergelt kollakas.
10868.de: A landscape view looking down from an elevation onto a lake and its forest-covered shore and small islands. The foliage of the trees is slightly yellowish.

10869.d: Metsavaheline autotee. Silmapiiril paistab punane-valge buss.
10869.de: A road through the forest. A red-and-white bus is visible on the horizon.

10870.d: Valge linaga kaetud laual seisab vaas astritega, nõu pirnidega, roheline raamat ja ajakiri Looming.
10870.de: On a table covered with a white cloth stands a vase with asters, a vessel with pears, a green book and the magazine Looming.

10871.d: Aknalaual seisab kaks vaasi kohevate roosakate kimpudega, kann ja vaagen õuntega. Taamal paistab vanalinn.
10871.de: On the windowsill stand two vases with fluffy pinkish bouquets, a jug, and a platter with apples. In the background the old town can be seen.

10872.d: Helerohelise linaga kaetud laual kompositsioon kohalikest aedviljadest (kõrvits, punane paprika, sibul, küüslauk. Korvis õunad, kausis porgandid ja kurgid). Taustal draperii.
10872.de: A composition of local garden vegetables on a table covered with a light green cloth (pumpkin, red pepper, onion, garlic. Apples in a basket, carrots and cucumbers in a bowl). Drapery in the background.

10907.d: Naise täisfiguurportree veerandpöördes paremale. Portreteeritul seljas valge-puna triibuline põll ja helesinine särk, juuksed seatud krunni. Ümberringi fragmendid toa mööblist: vasakul lauanurk, paremal riiul.
10907.de: Full-figure portrait of a woman in a three-quarter turn to the right. The sitter wears a white-and-red striped apron and a light blue shirt, hair arranged in a bun. Around her, fragments of room furniture: a table corner on the left, a shelf on the right.

10909.d: Hallikas-rohekal taustal mehe rindportree veerandpöördes paremale. Õlgadele langeva punase rätiga portreteeritu hoiab käes pintslit.
10909.de: Bust portrait of a man against a greyish-green background, in a three-quarter turn to the right. The sitter, with a red kerchief falling onto his shoulders, holds a brush in his hand.

10919.d: Istuva noore naise portree en face. Kujutataval seljas roheline pluus ja punane seelik, õlgadel tume karusnahkne kasukas. Tustal pastelsetes toonides geomeetrilise mustriga kardin.
10919.de: Portrait of a seated young woman en face. The subject wears a green blouse and a red skirt, on the shoulders a dark fur coat. In the background a curtain in pastel tones with a geometric pattern.

12395.dm: kõrgus: 32.0 cm; sügavus: 22.5 cm; laius: 43.5 cm

Kostüüm II maalimasõja järgse moe kohane. Figuuri järgiv kampsun soosiga, kindad, kaeluses lühike seoses sall, avaralt laienev lühike seelik. Jalas iluuisusaapad uiskudega. Kuklasse kinnitatud poolpikad juuksed, pea katmata.
12395.de: A young girl in a skater's pose, resting on a straight right leg, the left leg slightly bent at the knee and stretched back, the upper body parallel to the ground, arms raised to the sides. The costume corresponds to the fashion of the post-Second World War period. A close-fitting sweater with a raglan sleeve, gloves, a short knotted scarf at the neckline, a short, widely flaring skirt. Figure skating boots with skates on the feet. Half-long hair fastened at the nape, head uncovered.

12402.de: A young man with hair combed back over his head, in a singlet, wide trousers and fisherman's boots stands stooping on the quay in a dynamic pose. His left hand is raised to his open, shouting mouth as a megaphone, his right hand holds a coil of rope, which the man is about to throw. At his feet a bollard (a metal device fixed to a quay for mooring boats) with a boat's rope lying on the quay; the base is irregularly shaped
